chapters.title: Chapter 160: One Against All
paragraphs: BOOOOOOM!!
Vritra propelled himself forward with all his strength as he kicked the air, creating a huge sonic boom, then crossing his hands in front of his face, he used his own body like a weapon.

Tearing the bodies of anyone who came in front of him as he flew at extremely fast speed, but not a single drop of blood was present on his body, all of it was destroyed by the bluish demonic energy raging out.

People who were torn into two but were unlucky enough to have survived fell to the ground and cried while begging for help, like a train Vritra killed hundreds of men as he arrived at the other end within moments.

Then a metallic shadow flew out of his body. Catching it, Vritra pulled his right hand back as he exerted full strength, even using SHIFT and partial dragon transformation to maximize the power output.
BOOOOOOOOOOM!!

Then with an explosive sound, he shot Bob forward. At first, it was the size of a cricket ball, but right before entering the large group of humans, its size increased to the maximum, as a blood scene ensued.

A couple thousand men were turned into minced meat as they were killed the moment the metallic sphere collided against their bodies. After crossing through the group and leaving behind blood and meat, Bob began to circle in the air, killing every human.
In such a short time, Vritra had killed the entire army that the Nine Pacts had brought. Now only six men along with Faceless remained from that organization.

"Noooooo!! You damned demon, I am going to kill you!" Faceless roared. Even though from his perspective these people could be considered weak, over ten thousand men with levels up to nine hundred had been killed and that was a huge loss.
Vritra had killed more than twenty thousand men from the Nine Pacts.
Faceless and his four companions all looked at one another. One who had his head blown earlier had also returned, though he was still very weak and healing.
Blunder and the nine strong men from his team also glanced at one another, while the three demon generals did the same. Their first priority was to kill him, everything would come after that.
But Blunder was still reluctant to remove the barrier. How could he just trust an evil organization and demons? So he decided to check how strong Vritra currently is.

Faint lines had appeared over Vritra’s body. Such dense energy was still impossible for him to control completely, but the Elegy Parasite wouldn’t stop until the danger had disappeared. It was using Vritra’s life force to continue its rampage. That was why his body was able to hold on until now.
Plus, all the level gains increased his strength.
Nineteen of the strongest men from the three organizations ignored the dust storm, letting it hurt them a bit as they charged towards Vritra, using as much strength as they could.
Of course, they couldn’t use above level two thousand.
In the next instant, the large bull demon appeared in front of Vritra. Thaddeus’s speed wasn’t any slower than Vritra’s despite the strength restriction.
ROOAAAAAARRRRRRRRR

With a mad roar, he struck the bat-shaped staff at Vritra’s head. It wasn’t just Vritra’s strength that had been increased thanks to the Elegy Parasite at the cost of his life energy, but even his agility, reaction speed, raw fighting techniques—everything had improved by levels.
As the staff came down toward his head, Morvik flashed behind him and attacked Vritra with his countless sharp hands, aiming to cut him into pieces at once.
A dust clone separated from Vritra’s body in that instant, appearing exactly in front of him, as Vritra kicked at the clone’s back, sending it flying towards the staff while pushing himself backward.

Using his dust ability along with Intra Shuffle, his body twisted into a strange shape and all the sharp legs barely passed through his skin. He grabbed two of the legs with his hands. His heart pumped waves of demonic energy towards his arms as they bulged and veins popped—only to be healed in the next moment.
Then he swung the large insect toward the descending staff that easily crushed the dust clone. Everything happened so fast that Thaddeus had no time to pull back.
BOOOOOOM
With a resounding boom, Morvik’s body collided with the staff as he was thrown away at such a fast speed, only stopping when he collided with the barrier.
But Vritra had no time to rest. Just as Morvik was sent flying, he felt his body becoming slower and something inside him began to burn as Blunder’s thunderous laughter sounded.

"Blood!! I love blood! Everyone has it. Even if you have this sudden spurt of power, your body is still weak. Show me how you are going to get out of this." He let out a loud shout and poured out more and more energy, trying to make Vritra’s blood boil and explode.

Vritra only glanced at Blunder, his pitch-black eyes and emotionless face as serene as ever. Moving from his position quickly, he dodged attacks from two red-clothed persons from Bone Blood Cult, who were attacking him while also maintaining the barrier.
Vritra took a long breath and then...
THUMP... THUMP...
THUMP THUMP THUMP THUMP

His heartbeat grew rapidly and the two hearts pumped the purplish blood all across his body. These two new hearts seemed to have many capabilities—they not only increased his regeneration speed but also made him faster and could nullify most poison or internal problems.
Vritra’s body soon returned to normal as Blunder’s attack was nullified completely. Dozens of men attacked him at the same time right at that moment.
Their speed was quite similar to Vritra’s current speed, so even with his instincts working at full throttle, he was barely dodging the barrage of attacks.
He leaned forward as he dodged a sharp energy cut that almost grazed his back, but instantly several attacks aiming at his head and torso were launched.
Using all the skills, Vritra was barely competing with the fourteen men while the three generals, Faceless and Blunder charged their attacks and waited for the right moment to join.

A tiny cut appeared on his left arm just as Vritra had kicked one of the men away. They were all moving so fast in the sky that they left afterimages all over the sky and the explosive sounds continued to ring out each and every moment.
Just as Vritra moved out of the encirclement of those men, he sensed an extremely dangerous attack coming from behind, and there was no time to dodge or rotate.
Using the Intra Shuffle, Vritra’s body twisted in a disturbing manner. While standing in the same posture, his hands, head, torso, legs—everything twisted and now he was facing the other side.
It was Faceless who was launching the attack. Because of the barrier, he couldn’t even properly utilize his ’Field’ ability, so he could only use however much strength was available.
BOOOOOOOOOOM!!
Vritra barely had any time to put his arms forward as Faceless’s palm struck him and sent him flying. He collided into the ground and created an even larger crater.
Everything finally became quiet. They all wondered if that attack had successfully injured or taken him out. But then...
[Switch: Demonification (2%)]

sentences.text: BOOOOOOM!!
Vritra propelled himself forward with all his strength as he kicked the air, creating a huge sonic boom, then crossing his hands in front of his face, he used his own body like a weapon.

Tearing the bodies of anyone who came in front of him as he flew at extremely fast speed, but not a single drop of blood was present on his body, all of it was destroyed by the bluish demonic energy raging out.

People who were torn into two but were unlucky enough to have survived fell to the ground and cried while begging for help, like a train Vritra killed hundreds of men as he arrived at the other end within moments.
Then a metallic shadow flew out of his body.
Catching it, Vritra pulled his right hand back as he exerted full strength, even using SHIFT and partial dragon transformation to maximize the power output.
BOOOOOOOOOOM!!
Then with an explosive sound, he shot Bob forward.
At first, it was the size of a cricket ball, but right before entering the large group of humans, its size increased to the maximum, as a blood scene ensued.
A couple thousand men were turned into minced meat as they were killed the moment the metallic sphere collided against their bodies.
After crossing through the group and leaving behind blood and meat, Bob began to circle in the air, killing every human.
In such a short time, Vritra had killed the entire army that the Nine Pacts had brought.
Now only six men along with Faceless remained from that organization.
"Noooooo!!
You damned demon, I am going to kill you!" Faceless roared.
Even though from his perspective these people could be considered weak, over ten thousand men with levels up to nine hundred had been killed and that was a huge loss.
Vritra had killed more than twenty thousand men from the Nine Pacts.
Faceless and his four companions all looked at one another.
One who had his head blown earlier had also returned, though he was still very weak and healing.
Blunder and the nine strong men from his team also glanced at one another, while the three demon generals did the same.
Their first priority was to kill him, everything would come after that.
But Blunder was still reluctant to remove the barrier.
How could he just trust an evil organization and demons?
So he decided to check how strong Vritra currently is.
Faint lines had appeared over Vritra’s body.
Such dense energy was still impossible for him to control completely, but the Elegy Parasite wouldn’t stop until the danger had disappeared.
It was using Vritra’s life force to continue its rampage.
That was why his body was able to hold on until now.
Plus, all the level gains increased his strength.
Nineteen of the strongest men from the three organizations ignored the dust storm, letting it hurt them a bit as they charged towards Vritra, using as much strength as they could.
Of course, they couldn’t use above level two thousand.
In the next instant, the large bull demon appeared in front of Vritra.
Thaddeus’s speed wasn’t any slower than Vritra’s despite the strength restriction.
ROOAAAAAARRRRRRRRR
With a mad roar, he struck the bat-shaped staff at Vritra’s head.

It wasn’t just Vritra’s strength that had been increased thanks to the Elegy Parasite at the cost of his life energy, but even his agility, reaction speed, raw fighting techniques—everything had improved by levels.
As the staff came down toward his head, Morvik flashed behind him and attacked Vritra with his countless sharp hands, aiming to cut him into pieces at once.
A dust clone separated from Vritra’s body in that instant, appearing exactly in front of him, as Vritra kicked at the clone’s back, sending it flying towards the staff while pushing himself backward.
Using his dust ability along with Intra Shuffle, his body twisted into a strange shape and all the sharp legs barely passed through his skin.
He grabbed two of the legs with his hands.
His heart pumped waves of demonic energy towards his arms as they bulged and veins popped—only to be healed in the next moment.
Then he swung the large insect toward the descending staff that easily crushed the dust clone.
Everything happened so fast that Thaddeus had no time to pull back.
BOOOOOOM
With a resounding boom, Morvik’s body collided with the staff as he was thrown away at such a fast speed, only stopping when he collided with the barrier.
But Vritra had no time to rest.
Just as Morvik was sent flying, he felt his body becoming slower and something inside him began to burn as Blunder’s thunderous laughter sounded.
"Blood!!
I love blood!
Everyone has it.
Even if you have this sudden spurt of power, your body is still weak.
Show me how you are going to get out of this." He let out a loud shout and poured out more and more energy, trying to make Vritra’s blood boil and explode.
Vritra only glanced at Blunder, his pitch-black eyes and emotionless face as serene as ever.
Moving from his position quickly, he dodged attacks from two red-clothed persons from Bone Blood Cult, who were attacking him while also maintaining the barrier.
Vritra took a long breath and then...
THUMP...
THUMP...
THUMP THUMP THUMP THUMP
His heartbeat grew rapidly and the two hearts pumped the purplish blood all across his body.
These two new hearts seemed to have many capabilities—they not only increased his regeneration speed but also made him faster and could nullify most poison or internal problems.
Vritra’s body soon returned to normal as Blunder’s attack was nullified completely.
Dozens of men attacked him at the same time right at that moment.
Their speed was quite similar to Vritra’s current speed, so even with his instincts working at full throttle, he was barely dodging the barrage of attacks.
He leaned forward as he dodged a sharp energy cut that almost grazed his back, but instantly several attacks aiming at his head and torso were launched.
Using all the skills, Vritra was barely competing with the fourteen men while the three generals, Faceless and Blunder charged their attacks and waited for the right moment to join.
A tiny cut appeared on his left arm just as Vritra had kicked one of the men away.
They were all moving so fast in the sky that they left afterimages all over the sky and the explosive sounds continued to ring out each and every moment.
Just as Vritra moved out of the encirclement of those men, he sensed an extremely dangerous attack coming from behind, and there was no time to dodge or rotate.
Using the Intra Shuffle, Vritra’s body twisted in a disturbing manner.
While standing in the same posture, his hands, head, torso, legs—everything twisted and now he was facing the other side.
It was Faceless who was launching the attack.
Because of the barrier, he couldn’t even properly utilize his ’Field’ ability, so he could only use however much strength was available.
BOOOOOOOOOOM!!
Vritra barely had any time to put his arms forward as Faceless’s palm struck him and sent him flying.
He collided into the ground and created an even larger crater.
Everything finally became quiet.
They all wondered if that attack had successfully injured or taken him out.
But then...
[Switch: Demonification (2%)]

chapters.title: Chapter 161: The Bloody Demon
paragraphs: [Switch: Demonification (2%)]
An even more devastating energy burst out of that crater, making all the people shiver. Even the three generals who were supposedly the strongest in the barrier were no exceptions.

The whole of the barrier became suffocated by the dense energy as a deadly presence appeared in the crater. A blur shot out of the large hall, and even the strongest men couldn’t properly follow his figure.
BOOOOOOOOM

An enormous explosion sounded—the first strike landed on Faceless. His body shot back like a rocket as he coughed blood and his eyes bulged. It seemed that after such a long time, he had finally received an injury, as he felt the pain coursing through his entire body.
Even a few of his ribs seemed to have been broken. With a loud sound, he collided with the barrier and slid down while groaning in pain.
Just as Vritra’s punch had landed over Faceless’s body, his right fist had exploded right on impact because of the huge force.
There was no way his body could hold that much power just yet, even after the partial dragon transformation. As scales grew all across his body, he was slowly breaking apart.

But under the two hearts pumping wildly, purplish veins grew almost magically, and in the next moment, his hand had healed. Under the devastating power of the demon lord, cracks had started to form all across his body, and the life force was being consumed even faster.

Vritra’s long hair turned completely white within moments. He wasted no time as he flashed in front of Thaddeus—the most straightforward fighter, but also the strongest here. But Silquor, who had been preparing a spell, suddenly disappeared from the sky, and Vritra’s body paused unnaturally in the space.
The old figure of one of the demon generals appeared behind him.

With a hateful look, he shot both his hands forward. His nails had gone dark and very sharp. Using one of his deadliest poisons, he wanted to greatly weaken this strange demon so that his body could no longer hold that power.
SQUENCH
Silquor’s hands pierced right through Vritra’s chest. This was one of the strongest spells in his possession, directly affecting the space and formed by combining hundreds of top-level spells.
If he got enough time to set it up, even warriors much stronger than himself wouldn’t be able to survive against this attack.

Blood spurted out of Vritra’s chest, and a trail of purplish blood leaked from his mouth. But his body suddenly twisted as his head and arms rotated, and he looked at Silquor with those emotionless eyes. The black eyeballs seemed to have instilled fear in the old demon’s body.

Vritra slashed vertically with his right hand and cut off both of Silquor’s arms. Then, moving his arms at full speed, he struck Silquor’s head from either side, as his ears exploded and a strong shockwave passed through his body.

Silquor’s eyes turned white as foam came out of his mouth and he began to fall back. Vritra wasted no time as he clenched both fists and again struck from both sides of his head, and used dust to hold him in place.
BOOOM BOOOM BOOOM BOOOM
The others were frozen with fear as they watched Silquor’s head slowly turn into mush under the constant barrage of attacks.
Right now, the Elegy Parasite was working at more than a hundred times higher efficiency than Vritra—calculating every single danger and then counterattacking with the best possible route.
ROOOAAAARRRRRR
Thaddeus roared and charged forward to save his friend, but in the next moment, Vritra’s body twisted back—as if this was the moment he had been waiting for.

All the people trembled in horror as Vritra threw away both of Silquor’s hands from his chest, which left behind a gaping hole. Then he inserted his own hand into his chest and gripped one of his hearts.
DRIP DRIP

Then he pulled one of his own hearts out. The purple heart was still beating in his palm as Vritra coughed blood, and his body’s condition worsened. But none of it affected his fighting prowess as he disappeared and flashed in front of Thaddeus.

The large bull that was madly charging forward while roaring froze as he sensed the destructive power in Vritra’s palm. Even he felt fear for his life. But Vritra reacted faster. He thrust his hand forward and put it inside Thaddeus’s mouth—stuffing his own heart into his throat.

Then Vritra disappeared from the space. His hearts not only increased various of his abilities, but they also gave him two lives. Even if he were to die again, he would be resurrected instantly. Another part of his terrifying hearts was that they could contain a large amount of energy and could be used like bombs—extremely terrifying and destructive bombs full of the demon lord’s energy.

Even though Vritra’s condition had worsened, as only one heart was doing all the work now and the amount of energy was too large, with the help of the demonic energy he began to heal. He was a demon after all, so this blue energy was like the perfect and most potent healing potion as well.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!

Thaddeus had reacted just as fast as he could and sliced his throat to pull out the bomb, but only half of the heart was pulled out when it exploded. The blue demonic energy instantly consumed his head.
It was impossible to believe that someone with such a level had managed to deal so much damage to someone of Thaddeus’s caliber, even with his power restricted.
His neck, shoulders, and half his chest were blasted away and disappeared, and his body struck the ground, creating a massive hole as he then lay motionless—though he was still far from dead.
Upon seeing such a scene, Blunder’s body shivered and he finally understood that this was not the time to continue with his schemes. Their lives really might be in danger in front of that demon.
Just as he was about to remove the barrier, Blunder saw another horrifying scene as Vritra struck Morvik and, within a few short moments, injured him badly.

Then he disappeared again. The demonic energy flooded in the air as everything became still for a moment. Then—over ten thousand members of the Bone Blood Cult exploded at the same time, their bodies falling to the ground in pieces.
It was such a terrifying scene. Such a large army was gone in an instant just like that with one of Vritra’s strikes. The stench of blood became even thicker as the barrier finally disappeared.
But now, Thaddeus, Silquor, and Morvik were badly injured, so they wouldn’t be able to use more power anyway. Only Faceless was somewhat fine—he had benefited from the removal of the barrier.

Vritra gave them no time. This time, his target was Blunder. He appeared behind the psycho so fast that even the space buzzed slightly. Blunder felt as if time had slowed down. He began to turn his head as his terrified eyes focused on Vritra’s hand—those demonic hands that could rip anything apart.
SWIISSSSHHHHHHH
CRUNCH

Then, with a heart-wrenching sound, Vritra’s fingers tore through his skin and flesh as he tightly gripped Blunder’s spine—and with a loud sound, pulled it out of his body, leaving the crazy man broken and in unimaginable pain.

chapters.title: Chapter 162: Terrorized
paragraphs: Blunder’s eyes almost popped as his body twisted and blood spurted out of his nose and mouth. With a resounding crunch, Vritra pulled out Blunder’s spine. The lunatic’s body seemed to curl forward into a round shape as he let out a painful wail, but that was just the beginning.
"Aaaggghhhhhhh COUGH COUGH Ugggghhhhh"

Vritra’s body was on the verge of collapse. Two percent of the demon lord’s energy was way too much for him to handle. The Elegy Parasite was forcing his body past its limit as there was still danger around.

A terrifying amount of energy gathered in Vritra’s body, which seemed to have gone out of control. His body began to swell as if he were about to burst, but just at that moment he used Intra Shuffle and pushed all that energy towards his left hand.
Then he thrust his left hand into Blunder’s body, before cutting it off from just a bit above his wrist. Vritra disappeared from there in the next moment.
BOOOOOOOOOOM!!
A part of Blunder’s torso was blasted to pieces as his body bounced away and struck the ground. Vritra had given him no time to attack, otherwise the winning side might have really changed.
Vritra appeared again; he grabbed Blunder’s body by the throat and threw him into the sky before following behind at lightning speed.
BOOOM!!

A deafening punch landed on Blunder’s body as he coughed blood and let out a loud scream while his body was thrown in a different direction, only to be struck by Vritra again. He followed Blunder’s body in the sky, punching him with full strength and within moments reducing his battle prowess by over forty percent.
The lunatic Blunder’s body was completely covered in injuries from head to toe as he was thrown all over the sky like a ball, getting thrashed around.

Vritra’s condition worsened with each passing moment, and that was what all the enemies were aiming for. They knew he wouldn’t be able to handle that much power for too long, and when he was weak, they would easily be able to kill him.

But they had underestimated his battle prowess and strategy. Almost all the top powers in the forest were in a weakened state now—be it the three demon generals or Blunder. Faceless could still fight, but upon seeing Blunder getting beaten to a pulp, he changed his mind.

Vritra might get weak at some point, but if he stayed there, then he might really end up dead. He glanced at the corpses of his men and felt deep regret. Then gritting his teeth, he wasted no time and ran with all his might.
Bringing along the five men with him—if even these men died, then he really wouldn’t be able to explain it to his superiors.

Morvik acted fast as well. He grabbed the two others who were still in bad shape and flew at full speed. They would have the chance to obtain the demonic core later, but right now their lives were more important.

If those men had actually remained, then with Vritra’s deteriorating condition, they could have really succeeded in killing him since Vritra was not capable of holding onto this form for more than ten seconds.

As the Nine Pacts and the demon generals ran away, only the members of Bone Blood Cult remained. The nine men looked at one another and then at their army of more than ten thousand men before locking their gaze on their leader—that crazy and unruly man who acted like the world was his plaything.

Right now, he was getting beaten so badly that his past victims must be rejoicing from the afterlife. Those nine men knew that they had to help their boss, but just looking at that demon made them shiver. He was too scary.

Vritra struck Blunder’s head, and his skull cracked while both of his eyes popped out. With each strike, his injuries were getting worse, and the sky was filled with the sound of explosions and those painful wails.
BOOOOM BOOOOM BOOOOOM BOOOOOM

With each strike, the nine people watching the scene shivered. They too wanted to escape, but they couldn’t just leave behind their leader. Otherwise, if that psycho survived, then they would suffer even more.

One among the nine men gathered his courage and flew at full speed to catch Vritra off guard. Gathering energy in the sword in his hand, he appeared behind Vritra just when he had punched Blunder’s throat.

Then with all the strength the Bone Blood Cult’s man had, he slashed the sword at Vritra’s back. The sword cleaved through his body and cut him in two. At first, the cultist was surprised, but then terror struck him as he suddenly sensed the world rolling around.
WHOOOSH

Only the sound of air being torn was heard as the cultist began to fall to the ground in pieces—his limbs, head, torso—all of them had been torn to pieces within moments. He had no time to dodge or block.

At this point, Vritra had reached his peak state, but also the state where he seemed about to explode. This truly was the limit of his body—even with both his hearts working overtime, he could no longer handle so much energy.

But until the danger had disappeared or Vritra had died, his body wasn’t going to stop. Like a machine, he would keep on going. His pitch black eyes scanned the area and he saw the eight men standing there and shivering.

Vritra directly shot towards them, making them jump back in fear. Finally, they couldn’t hold on any longer. All eight of them turned around and decided to save their lives first. They could apologize to their leader later on, if he survived, that is.

All eight flew in different directions. With Vritra’s current condition, he was only able to catch one. That one unlucky cultist was torn to pieces just like the first one, and his body parts fell to the ground just beside the first.
The two weren’t dead yet. Killing these people was much harder than that, but they would be immobile for a while. Their bodies would continue to heal until then.
Finally, Vritra moved towards Blunder, who was trying to escape desperately. Stretching his right hand, Vritra called back one of his axes as it flew from the ground and headed toward his direction.
Just as he caught the handle of the axe, Vritra threw it toward Blunder’s back with all his might, as it tore through the air and struck his body in the next moment.
The axe was very powerful, but it was not enough to cut through Blunder’s body. Blunder let out a painful growl as the axe got stuck in his back, the large blade embedded into his skin and flesh.

Vritra shot forward, and using the last bits of his will and power, he kicked the hammer side of the axe. His feet almost exploded from using so much energy. Finally, the axe cut through Blunder’s body and he was sliced into two as both the parts began to fall.

Blunder’s eyes were full of hatred and fear as both parts stared at Vritra, before muttering something—and then his body exploded in blood. Using the Blood Sacrifice, Blunder made his escape. He was the hardest to kill.

He had no time to dodge or block.
At this point, Vritra had reached his peak state, but also the state where he seemed about to explode.
This truly was the limit of his body—even with both his hearts working overtime, he could no longer handle so much energy.
But until the danger had disappeared or Vritra had died, his body wasn’t going to stop.
Like a machine, he would keep on going.
His pitch black eyes scanned the area and he saw the eight men standing there and shivering.
Vritra directly shot towards them, making them jump back in fear.
Finally, they couldn’t hold on any longer.
All eight of them turned around and decided to save their lives first.
They could apologize to their leader later on, if he survived, that is.
All eight flew in different directions.
With Vritra’s current condition, he was only able to catch one.
That one unlucky cultist was torn to pieces just like the first one, and his body parts fell to the ground just beside the first.
The two weren’t dead yet.
Killing these people was much harder than that, but they would be immobile for a while.
Their bodies would continue to heal until then.
Finally, Vritra moved towards Blunder, who was trying to escape desperately.
Stretching his right hand, Vritra called back one of his axes as it flew from the ground and headed toward his direction.
Just as he caught the handle of the axe, Vritra threw it toward Blunder’s back with all his might, as it tore through the air and struck his body in the next moment.
The axe was very powerful, but it was not enough to cut through Blunder’s body.
Blunder let out a painful growl as the axe got stuck in his back, the large blade embedded into his skin and flesh.
Vritra shot forward, and using the last bits of his will and power, he kicked the hammer side of the axe.
His feet almost exploded from using so much energy.
Finally, the axe cut through Blunder’s body and he was sliced into two as both the parts began to fall.
Blunder’s eyes were full of hatred and fear as both parts stared at Vritra, before muttering something—and then his body exploded in blood.
Using the Blood Sacrifice, Blunder made his escape.
He was the hardest to kill.

chapters.title: Chapter 163: And the battle ends...
paragraphs: Just as both the parts of Blunder’s body disappeared, Vritra could no longer hold on as he coughed out purple-colored blood and his body fell to the ground. The demonic energy was going berserk again, and he urgently needed to shut the demon lord’s core.
But before that, he had a bit more work to do. He pushed his body off the ground with difficulty and then scanned the large space with his black eyes.
The two men from the Bone Blood Cult were continuing to heal as they lay there silently. More than twenty thousand men were dead from Bone Blood Cult and the Nine Pacts.

Some distance away, a group of more than twenty men lay unconscious. This was the group that Vritra had brought along on the journey—the guards and the coachmen. They had somehow survived the entire battle, but under Vritra’s suffocating aura, they had long since fallen unconscious.
The escaping enemies had no interest in going back to check or attack Vritra; they had already traveled a long distance, so they weren’t a threat.
The only danger remaining right now were the two men who lay in pieces. Vritra held his breath as he dragged his body forward.
Upon arriving in front of the two men who looked at him in horror and with pleading eyes, Vritra first stabilized his swaying body. Then he extended both hands toward the two.

Blue energy rushed out of his hands wildly as it consumed the two men. Their screams reverberated across the entire place as every piece of their bodies began to melt and got destroyed under the destructive energy.

Vritra had reduced the amount of energy he was drawing back from 2% to 1%; that was why he was able to hold on for a few more seconds. He continued to burn their bodies until their bodies had died and their breathing stopped.

At that moment, two white wisps of energy shot out of their bodies. It was their souls, and they were still trying to escape in this form. Vritra focused his mind on the two souls as the third eye opened on his forehead.

Vritra swayed backward as he shot a mental attack at both of them. The souls trembled, but after a slight pause, they continued to fly. But Vritra launched one attack after another even as his body grew paler and he began to bleed even more.
But his soul was still much weaker than those people. His mental attack wasn’t having much of an effect on them except for slowing them down a bit and making them exhausted.

Seeing that Vritra’s attacks were ineffective against them, the two men were overjoyed. Even though the destruction of their bodies was a great loss, if they could survive, then everything would be fine.
Just then, another heavy presence appeared.
"Let me handle them."

Yasmine’s voice sounded as she flew out of Vritra’s body in her enormous dragon form. Just her sight and presence froze the two men—they were completely baffled by the sight of such a majestic dragon.
"A d-dragon? How can this be p-possible?" the first man asked as his soul was frozen and wouldn’t budge no matter how much he tried.

"Just how many secrets is h-he hiding in his body? A demon and now a dragon? Who did our maniac leader offend exactly? Can’t he c-choose his targets more wisely?" the other soul spoke in fear, their soul bodies shivering.
ROOOOOAAAAAAAARRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR

Yasmine let out an explosive roar that shook even the people who were trying to escape. Any thought left of going back after a while was instantly crushed. They didn’t want to go anywhere near that demon—ever.

A wave of invisible energy shot out of Yasmine’s body as it hit the two souls again and again, gradually weakening them greatly. Killing them was not hard for her, but it wouldn’t really give her any benefit as her level was already too high and it was her husband’s prey.
So, she looked back at Vritra. After staring at his strange state, she just said two words before disappearing:
"Kill them."
Vritra locked onto the two souls and again launched a wave of mental attacks at them from his Nether Eye. This time, his attacks were very effective as the two souls screamed and began to burn up.

After a few seconds, the souls were finally destroyed as several messages popped in front of Vritra. The Elegy Parasite was about to disappear, but just before leaving, it scanned the entire place one more time and could only see thousands of corpses around him.
With a thought, he stored all the corpses in his inventory—even the two men who were at the 2nd Legion rank, which means above level two thousand.

Finally, he locked away the demonic energy and fell back, his body too injured and completely exhausted. His long white hair stuck to his bloodied body. There were so many injuries all over, and his condition was very bad.
He had fallen unconscious as Elegy Parasite disappeared. All the danger had been taken care of.

Yasmine observed Vritra silently. The moment Vritra died, the confines set by him had been undone. But the shock was so much that she had fainted, and when she woke up, Vritra had just torn Blunder in two.

She was angry at him for locking her away when he was suffering so much, but she still couldn’t leave her husband in the open like that. So, she scanned the surroundings and soon found a cave within the forest, where some animals lived.
Yasmine looked at the unconscious men in the distance. She wondered if she should kill them all—after all, they might have seen Vritra in his demonic form.
And she had even sensed that one or two of them had woken up and were just pretending to be asleep when she came out just now. But she had made them unconscious again, so they didn’t see her.

But after thinking for a moment, she decided not to. They might spread news about Vritra, about him being a demon or demon lord in the making or whatnot. But several other men had also seen that. There was no point in killing them, as that work could be done by Bone Blood Cult or Nine Pacts as well.
So she came out of Vritra’s body again. Her heart ached as she looked at his bruised and battered body. Wrapping herself around him carefully, the small white dragon flew away hastily.
Yasmine scared away the demons living in that cave with her aura and gently put down Vritra. She pulled healing potions from his inventory and began to feed him one bottle after another.

’He had lost a lot of life energy...’Yasmine thought while looking at his white hair. But she wasn’t much worried about this aspect. Such a thing could be taken care of with potions, treasure, or if he breaks through the Legion rank.

And not to mention his godly skill that is like his sugar mummy, always giving him whatever he needs whenever he needs. She was sure that soon the condition of his body will be scanned by Mutamorphis, and his healing skill will evolve.
"Sigh, what an abnormality you are, hubby..."
Yasmine shook her head as she continued to stare at Vritra, who seemed to have changed a lot in such a short time.

chapters.title: Chapter 164: The Grieves (Final!!)
paragraphs: In the distance, inside a moving carriage.
Fiona was shocked by the sudden events. She couldn’t understand what happened all of a sudden—one moment they were traveling in silence and the next, Vanessa reacted so strongly.
She even fainted in the end, and seeing Diana’s expression, the redhead knew that something really bad might have happened.
But she didn’t ask while Diana was taking care of the unconscious Vanessa. They continued to move towards Blue Kingdom, while the goddess looked quite anxious.
After some time, Vanessa woke up, but then she broke out even more. She cried and tried to get out of the carriage, while Diana stopped her, telling things like—
Even if you go, you won’t be able to change anything and that it’s too late, and that he at least wanted to protect his mother.
Vanessa was crying while Diana was trying to calm her down, but suddenly, the two women froze and they looked at one another in confusion.
Vanessa wiped away her tears and asked in puzzlement, "Is he...?"
"Yeah, I can sense it too. He is alive." The goddess replied with a quizzical look on her face. She seemed just as confused.

But after a couple of seconds, everything else disappeared, and Vanessa was full of joy. There was no way that her son would die so easily; she just sat there silently and closed her eyes, praying for Vritra’s safe return.
All this while Fiona just looked at the two women in confusion, wondering if they were doing some kind of play, having no idea about the major events that had just transpired.
Inside the Blue Kingdom, major powers had started to gather, and many people who stood at the top of humanity gathered there for the inheritance of the Scarlet couple.
The kingdom was as lively as it could be, but lingering in that kingdom that was so peaceful on the surface were unknown dangers.
In a dark alley, a man at the Legion rank ran with all his might while a shadowy figure ran behind him.

The two figures soon disappeared into the darkness, a loud scream rang out, and after a few seconds, the same man walked calmly out of the darkness—but his manner and expressions were completely different from before.
There exist creatures that humans, demons, dragons, and every other race fear the same; they are creatures the world knows very little about. Their origins are quite the mystery.
The most special of their abilities known by the world is to possess other lifeforms and then either exist along with them or, after devouring them, take over the body completely.

And they are also quite popular in their capabilities of creating glyphs. The genius creator of the glyphs had suddenly disappeared one day, and there was a myth that Rodrick Mech was possessed by one such creature and that is how they got so good at creating glyphs.
Blunder—or rather the Bone Blood Cult—had made a deal with them, which was why everyone was so shocked upon seeing those glyphs.
These strange types of creatures are called—’The Grieves.’
The Grieves were hunted by every race and had been declared as evil and enemies of the world, so these creatures could only hide from everyone and exist secretly.

The newly possessed human walked calmly through the streets as he smiled and looked around, and soon made his way into a large temple. The door was shut, but when he arrived there, the guards opened the door and allowed him to enter after making sure it was one of them.

As the man walked into the temple, he took one of the seats and looked around with a wide smile. Sitting in that large temple were hundreds upon hundreds of Grieves... all of them were above the Legion ranks.
A large storm was soon coming to the Blue Kingdom.

Inside the cave in the forest, Vritra rested for a few hours. He slept like a log without a care in the world. As some of the outer injuries healed under Yasmine’s care, the devoted and loving wife performed her duties with all her heart.

She didn’t know what exactly Mutamorphis had done, but gradually, Vritra’s hair was returning to black. But those two horns remained over his head—he had completely left behind his humanity and become a true demon.

His origin was that of a demon, although he was part dragon as well. But his origins weren’t of the dragons, which Yasmine didn’t like one bit. She had already made up her mind to transform her husband into a true dragon, though even she wasn’t sure how he would mutate then and could only hope that his demon side wouldn’t clash with it.
But that was something which wouldn’t be happening very soon, so Yasmine focused on cleaning his body, dressing him, healing him.
After a few hours, Vritra finally woke up. His eyes fluttered open and the first thing he saw was the anxious face of his wife. She hovered right in front of him.
"Are you feeling better?" she asked, her voice full of worry.
Vritra still couldn’t move his body. He took in several breaths before he was finally able to speak weakly.
"Y-Yeah..."
Seeing that Vritra would be fine after some time of healing, Yasmine’s expression changed. She gave a softhmphsound and pouted cutely as she turned her head away, showing that she was angry at him.
Vritra smiled slightly, but his skin and flesh were still in so much pain. After a pause, he asked, "Are you angry at me?"
Yasmine: "..."

She ignored him. She was so angry at him for locking her away while he was facing all those monsters all alone. He was literally killed by them. She didn’t know if she would have been able to live for a moment longer if Vritra had really disappeared from her life.
So this was the least he had to face—her silent treatment—and it did feel nice when he tried to appease her anger.

"I am sorry, I will never do that again. So can you speak now? I know I was wrong to make you feel all that, but I didn’t want to put you in danger." Vritra spoke. He did like her cute behavior but didn’t want her to be angry.
Yasmine: "..."

"Sigh... I am really sorry. The next time I am in mortal danger, I will use you as my shield and throw you at the enemy, and the moment you bring down the enemies along with your soul, I will make my graceful escape, completely unscathed while mourning for you in my heart," Vritra said in all seriousness.
"You—" Yasmine suddenly turned and stared at him. He still had the nerve to joke around.
Vritra chuckled lightly before a painful expression appeared on his face. His body was still in very bad condition.
"Are you okay?" Yasmine instantly came close to him and asked in worry. She couldn’t keep up with her angry act.
"Y-Yeah, I am fine—" Vritra was just replying to her when a few messages popped in front of him and the two looked at the messages at the same time.
[Divine Sin Arrow successfully merged with Divine Sin Wheel.]
[Would you like to open your new status panel?]
Now that everything had ended, this thing had finally appeared.
Yasmine: "..."
Vritra: "You bitch—"

{SHIFT}{UPGRADE: 20 million Sin points.}
{Intra Shuffle}{UPGRADE: 20 million Sin points.}

Vritra stared at the new system menu while feasting on the demonic meat. Almost three days had passed since the fight with those three organizations; his body had completely healed and even his life force was replenished.
He cast a long shadow over the cave’s wall, his two horns making him appear like a true devil.
It seemed the Divine Sin Arrow’s main ability was to allow him to upgrade various of his skills, and he could now even purchase skill points and luck points.

It was a great change — with enough sin points, he could upgrade all his skills and buy a lot of skill points and luck points. And when his luck reached high enough, he would be able to draw skills so easily.
Though everything seemed quite expensive, as long as he could find a big crowd, earning those sin points would be a piece of cake.
Wiping the blood from the corner of his lips, Vritra gulped the last bite and drank some water.
"Wifey, why has my level paused at 999? Surely after killing those two 2nd Legion-ranked men I should be much higher," he asked and stood up, stretching his body as cracking sounds rang out.
"It’s a huge jump to that level. A major part of your experience points has been stored, and to evolve you would first need a 1st Grade Legion Stone," Yasmine explained.
"Is that too rare to find?" Vritra walked out of the cave as all the animals around the cave ran away in panic just from the faint aura that leaked out of his body.
"Not really, but the Legion Stone is based on a person’s field. While in your case, your leveling up was too fast, so I don’t know what might be your field.

Normally, people form strong connections with a certain ability, element, or anything, but for you, it can be dust, spatial field, fire, demonic energy, or many others. So we would have to search for a 1st Grade Empty Legion Stone. It can be used for any ability, though it’s a little rare," she replied.
[Intra Shuffle Activated.]
The horns over his head twisted and soon disappeared — he couldn’t walk around humans with horns above his head after all. And while he was at it, he even changed his facial features slightly.

There was a high chance that he already might be a little popular, and evil organizations’ favorite thing is to eliminate enemies through a borrowed knife, so all the good organizations would come to hunt him if they heard even a little about him.

After he was done with his little preparation, Vritra flew into the sky and looked around, then he focused his gaze once again on the new system menu and decided to add all the allocation points to intelligence.
Now that he could just purchase the skill points, he no longer had to be very careful with them.
Stats:
Strength: 7818 (+100)
Endurance: 6937 (+100)
Intelligence: 6481 (+100)
Luck: 60
[Allocation points: 0]

"Now that this is done, it is finally time to head into the Blue Kingdom. I have to find Mom, Fiona, and Diana soon and also that empty Legion Stone. I can’t remain too weak for long," Vritra mumbled to himself.
He planned to annihilate all the people who had managed to escape very soon.
Since Bobby was still perfectly fine, he wasn’t as much worried about them, but looking down at his body, Vritra sighed in regret.
His armor was broken in a single strike from Blunder. If it was still fine, then he might have been able to upgrade it too in the future — but whatever was lost was lost, and he had gained a lot too.

The two men from the Bone Blood Cult were still lying as corpses in his inventory, waiting to be turned into soul wraiths, but with his current strength, Vritra couldn’t do that task. So as soon as he reaches the Legion rank, he would have two bodyguards way stronger than himself.
Not to mention those thousands of men he had killed who would increase the strength of his soul wraiths.
Hoooo.
Taking a deep breath, Vritra focused on the two hearts in his chest as they began to beat faster and faster, pumping blood throughout his body.
THUMP THUMP THUMP

Purple veins became sharply visible over his pale skin. In the next moment, Vritra shot forward, releasing a loud explosive sonic boom. Just those hearts seemed to have increased his already high agility by several times — Vritra tore through the air at a terrifying speed.
Many low-level 1st Legion-ranked people wouldn’t be as fast as Vritra was already. There was a devastating difference between his speed now and just three days ago.

Seriously though, the two hearts were one of the biggest treasures that he had received after his transformation. None of the poisons could affect him now, nor could most internal attacks like the one from Blunder.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]

Like a rocket, Vritra flew through the air but soon entered a different space. He didn’t plan to announce his arrival to everyone so openly — the Blue Kingdom was several times more dangerous than the Dunshire Kingdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 166: The Emerging Demon Lord
paragraphs: The atmosphere inside the Blue Kingdom was as lively as possible. For the past few days, a news had been especially popular inside the kingdom.
The emergence of a new Demon Lord—this news appeared out of nowhere and then spread like wildfire. All the newspapers were filled with that one single demonic image.

The photo of a single person killing thousands—those horns, those red eyes, and that terrifying presence—it was clear that he was a terrifying demon, and he was portrayed as the enemy of humanity, who was said to have killed thousands of innocent humans for no reason.
Every person was talking about him, though only a little was known about this person. His appearance, name, and a little about three women who were with him.

As Vritra approached the large gate of the Blue Kingdom, he paused in the sky and was surprised by the heavy security. Hundreds upon hundreds of guards were lined across the boundary. There were a lot of legion-ranked guards, too—many among them were wearing different uniforms than the kingdom guards.

Clearly, many other powerful people had entered the Blue Kingdom along with their large armies. Vritra could guess that it might be because of the emergence of the Scarlet Inheritance—that thing contained a huge treasure.
Vritra had obtained its map before. Although its location was clearly known to everyone, that map even showed all the traps, directions, paths, and much more. It could have been very useful but...
The danger associated with this inheritance was way too high. There was no way Vritra could contend against Yasmine or Demon Lord–ranked people just yet, so he had no choice but to give up.
But he still possessed the map that could help him find the 20th ranked Mythic Halo, which was enough.
Right now, he was wearing a black set of clothes, his hair was black, and even his facial expression had changed—he didn’t look one bit like the real himself.
Appearing in a dark alley outside the boundary of the Blue Kingdom, Vritra appeared out of his disappearing state and perfectly hid his aura.
Outside the boundary of the Blue Kingdom, lots of people had cleared a big part of the forest and built their houses; those places had transformed into various small cities.

Vritra walked towards the large gate; he sat down at a shop and asked them to bring tea. After looking around, he saw a man sitting not too far away. There were more than a dozen empty tea cups on his table as if he was waiting for someone.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +26}
After thinking for a moment, Vritra decided to get some information from this man. Vritra gave the order for two teas and sat in front of the impatient man.
"Hello, are you waiting for someone?" Vritra asked with a smile.
"Huh? Who are you?" The impatient man frowned and looked Vritra up and down but couldn’t recognize him.
"I am new here. Why is the security so heavy here?" Vritra paid for both their teas with a silver coin. Even tea’s price seemed to have skyrocketed because of the crowd.

"Ah, good lad, hehe, thank you.CoughHaven’t you heard of the new Demon Lord? Vritra—a Demon Lord in the making. Haven’t you heard about that? Recently he even slaughtered thousands of innocent humans and I even heard he ate their flesh—ugh, so terrifying. Anyway, everyone has heard that he would soon be entering the kingdom." The middle-aged man spoke with a grin.
Soon the tea for both arrived. Vritra continued to ask with his eyebrows raised in surprise: "A Demon Lord? So you are waiting for him? Do you want to catch him?"
{Sin Point Gained: Flustered +1}

"What?!! Catch him? Are you stupid, lad? There is no way I could do that." Shaking his head furiously, the middle-aged man gulped his tea before picking Vritra’s cup and continued: "I thought if I was lucky, maybe I could get to see him."
"Can you recognize him?" Vritra asked. He wanted to see which of his images was being circulated in the kingdom.
"..." While gulping another cup of tea, the middle-aged man took a piece of newspaper from his pocket and placed it over the table.
{Sin Point Gained: Speechless +1}

Vritra glanced at the photo and was really speechless. He wondered which among his enemies gave out this photo. It was the image after his demon transformation. He was slicing humans in that photo with a big evil smile—he was clearly portrayed as extremely evil.
"Anyway, I heard many important people are soon coming to this place, which is the main reason behind this much security." The middle-aged man added as he put away the paper.

This was as much as the middle-aged man knew. Vritra left that place and felt that his current disguise wasn’t good enough, so he entered a clothing shop, and after around half an hour, walked out of there.

He wore the clothes of traditional young masters from the big families, even holding a folding paper fan in his hand with some words written on either side of it. He had bought many different dresses just now.
Finally ready with his disguise, he began to walk towards the large door, but just then he heard distant noises, and he already knew who was approaching.
Sitting over the back of his bull that was running madly on the road was Monk Shitless. Wherever he passed, the bull knocked over many people, all of whom were cursing him loudly.
Just as the bull was close to Vritra, Shitless stopped the bull with all his might, though he ended up thrown off its back and skidded a bit across the floor before stopping in front of Vritra.
’Sigh, now I don’t even doubt this guy’s ability. But he followed me again? Just what is he planning?’ Vritra sighed and shook his head.
"What are you doing here?" Vritra asked, already aware that this baldie recognized him despite his disguise.

"Oh pitiful one, you know I am from the temple of the Blue Kingdom, and I am kind of popular here, so I can help you out a lot in this place." Monk Shitless stood up instantly and said with a flattering smile.
"Before anything, first tell me, why do you always linger around me? I might kill you myself if I find you suspicious." Vritra said, his red pupils staring down at the scared monk.
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +1}

"A-Actually, I enjoy watching bloodshed, violence, deaths... and in my entire life, I have never seen anyone with an aura as chaotic as yours, so I followed you. I promise I have no ill intentions. You can even order me around if you want." Monk Shitless spoke hastily.
"..." Vritra thought for a moment, and in the end, decided to bring the monk along. His real identity was already being hunted, and it wouldn’t be bad to have a little help in this new kingdom.
"Okay, let’s enter." Vritra said and began to walk towards the gate. Monk Shitless was overjoyed as he hastily followed.
Vritra hoped to enter peacefully and first search for the three women, but their journey inside was going to be anything but peaceful.

chapters.title: Chapter 167: Just let me handle everything...
paragraphs: Vritra and Monk Shitless walked towards the door. They stepped into the line, and with a confident smile on his face, the monk turned back to look at Vritra and spoke:
"Pitiful one, let me handle this one. You just stand and watch. I will bring you inside safely and respectfully, hehe, I am an expert when it comes to acting."
"...Okay." Vritra said with a skeptical look. He had some doubt about this strange monk who definitely chose the wrong profession.
After thirty minutes...
Hundreds of guards were running through the streets of the first city in the Blue Kingdom; they carried all kinds of weapons as they angrily ran behind two people while roaring wildly.
"You damned baldy, what the hell was that? Didn’t you say you would handle it?" Vritra scolded while standing beside Monk Shitless on the bull’s back.
"I-I tried my best." Monk Shitless said fearfully, while looking at the wave of guards that ran toward them like a tsunami.

"Weren’t you famous in this kingdom? Sigh, I should have known better." Vritra rolled his eyes. He glanced back at the guards, many among whom were also legion-ranked, but he wasn’t the least bit worried.
The moment they had joined the lines, this hateful and shitty Monk Shitless had started his damned acting. He went overboard with his words from the beginning.
"You just watch how I make those guards shiver in fear." Monk Shitless said with a wide grin, while Vritra was just fanning himself with the folding fan, already in character.

The guards were properly checking and asking a few questions to every person who wished to enter, so the pace was quite slow, and Vritra and Shitless still had more than thirty people standing in front of them.

After seeing that it was going to take a lot of time, Shitless began his act: "YOU IMBECILES!! How dare you make young master wait in a lowly place such as this? Are you courting death? Kowtow and beg for your mistakes."
Vritra: "..."
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +432}
{Sin Point Gained: Glared at +432}
{Sin Point Gained: Cursed +432}
All eyes turned towards them. The guards felt especially angry. The ones who were already in the legion rank almost tore that hateful mouth right there and then, but they didn’t act immediately.

After all, many important people were heading into the kingdom at this point, and some of them were bound to be arrogant. If they accidentally offended someone, then they might really end up in trouble.
Seeing all the hateful looks, Vritra took one step to the side, acting as if he didn’t know who the baldy was. It was not a good idea to expose himself so soon just for a few sin points.

"...Sir, may I know who exactly are you? And who is this young master you speak of?" one of the legion-ranked guards, who seemed to be one of the head guards of the Blue Kingdom, approached and asked.

"Hah, you dare to ask young master’s name? Do you wish to get nine of your generations killed and hanged outside young master’s grand kingdom?" Monk Shitless shouted in a loud voice, getting too much into the character.
"Sigh, where is this young master of yours?" The guard was getting really annoyed now and barely managed to hold back.

"Oh, he is..." Monk Shitless looked back to introduce the said young master, but there was no one behind him. He looked around in confusion and soon his gaze landed on Vritra, who stood to the side and held the paper fan in hand, hitting it over his palm.

"There he is, the great of all times, the young master of the century..." Shitless began to introduce in a dramatic tone as sin points rained down at Vritra along with the hatred of hundreds of people.

"He is Young Master Jin from the family Woo—Young Master Jin Woo. He is the descendant of a royal family from an even more majestic kingdom. Get the fuck out of our way and let us enter." The monk spoke.

"You are Jin Woo? I have never heard that name. Which kingdom are you exactly from? You both are not here just to cause trouble, right?" the head guard asked, trying to be polite but with anger evident in his eyes.

"Yes, I am Jin Woo. I am from the White Kingdom. Can we enter? We have something important to discuss with an important guest that should have arrived here already." Vritra said in a tone that was neither too submissive nor too offending.
The legion-ranked guard felt a bit better that at least this young master was better than that shitty baldy. Then he was surprised by those words.

"Oh, the White Kingdom? You are here for that as well, huh? But your strength is rather weak." He spoke. The White Kingdom was the majestic and biggest kingdom in their continent, several times more powerful than the Blue Kingdom.
Believing that these people might really be important, the head guard decided to be a bit more respectful and let them enter first after seeing some sort of proof.

Just then, one guard who had been staring at Monk Shitless from the beginning had a realizing look on his face. He ran towards the head guard and whispered something in his ear that Vritra and Monk Shitless heard all too well.
"Sir, don’t believe that baldy’s bullshit. I have seen him before. He is that fallen monk from the temple. I am sure you’ve heard his name before—’The Shitty Monk’, but he calls himself Shitless.
Anyway, he is a thug, a criminal that escaped from the kingdom after burning up the holy book in the temple." The guard added while glaring at the monk from the corner of his eyes.
GULP
Monk Shitless gulped visibly, his face turning pale. He forgot the most essential part of the plan—and that was to disguise himself. He glanced at Vritra and roared with all his might:
"BULLO, COME!!"

The bull came running through the crowd, as it continued to charge into the kingdom’s door. Monk Shitless jumped over its back in haste, while the others were still reeling in shock at the identity reveal.
Vritra stood there, hoping to get out of everyone’s sight silently, but the darned monk waved his hand and shouted:
"Young Master Jin Woo, hurry up! They are all bad people!!"

Vritra sighed and also jumped onto the bull’s back. The legion-ranked guard rolled his eyes as he ordered his men to catch them both. He had been ordered not to leave his post unless something serious happened, so just sending some guards to catch two powerless people should be easy, right?
And that is how they ended up in their current predicament.
"B-But I didn’t break your character until the end, did I, young master?" the monk said, hoping that Vritra would help him.
"Sigh, take care." Vritra sighed yet again and decided to part ways right there and then.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]
"Huh? What do you mean—Uwaaaaah!! Where are you, young master? Please don’t leave me alone, young masterrrrrrrr!!" Monk Shitless screamed as he continued to lure the guards away.
Vritra looked at him from the sky and felt that even in a foreign kingdom, he wouldn’t need that kind of help. Just then, he noticed something from the sky.

"Pitiful one, let me handle this one.

I will bring you inside safely and respectfully, hehe, I am an expert when it comes to acting."
"...Okay." Vritra said with a skeptical look.
He had some doubt about this strange monk who definitely chose the wrong profession.
After thirty minutes...
Hundreds of guards were running through the streets of the first city in the Blue Kingdom; they carried all kinds of weapons as they angrily ran behind two people while roaring wildly.
"You damned baldy, what the hell was that?
Didn’t you say you would handle it?" Vritra scolded while standing beside Monk Shitless on the bull’s back.
"I-I tried my best." Monk Shitless said fearfully, while looking at the wave of guards that ran toward them like a tsunami.
"Weren’t you famous in this kingdom?
Sigh, I should have known better." Vritra rolled his eyes.
He glanced back at the guards, many among whom were also legion-ranked, but he wasn’t the least bit worried.
The moment they had joined the lines, this hateful and shitty Monk Shitless had started his damned acting.
He went overboard with his words from the beginning.

Vritra: "..."

{Sin Point Gained: Glared at +432}

"Sigh, where is this young master of yours?" The guard was getting really annoyed now and barely managed to hold back.
"Oh, he is..." Monk Shitless looked back to introduce the said young master, but there was no one behind him.

"There he is, the great of all times, the young master of the century..." Shitless began to introduce in a dramatic tone as sin points rained down at Vritra along with the hatred of hundreds of people.

Get the fuck out of our way and let us enter." The monk spoke.

I have never heard that name.
Which kingdom are you exactly from?
You both are not here just to cause trouble, right?" the head guard asked, trying to be polite but with anger evident in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 168: The Temple
paragraphs: Vritra narrowed his eyes as he gazed into the distance while hovering in the air, staying in his disappearing state. He flew a bit higher and saw a large crowd gathered at a place more than ten kilometres away from him.
Even his senses had greatly improved after the demonic transformation. There were mostly young men, and all of them seemed rather excited—almost like a boy who was about to become a man.
’I wonder where Mom and the others are. Did they go to the temple? Maybe I should check that out—they should have arrived in this place a day before me.’ Vritra pondered.
Originally, the three women would have taken longer, but after paying more money, they got the fastest ride possible and arrived in the Blue Kingdom faster.
He decided to check that crowded place later. His first priority was to find them. He could sense Bobby’s presence, but it was hard to find their exact location.
He landed on the ground and removed the Fourth Dimension before walking calmly on the street. Vritra still looked quite handsome, so he was attracting quite a lot of gazes.

’Wifey, where do you think I can find that empty 1st Legion stone? Do you have any idea?’ Vritra asked while looking around casually. This place was a little similar to Dunshire, but most of the people here seemed richer, and this kingdom was definitely more advanced.
He noticed glyphs in the hands of many people, which was an extremely rare sight in the previous kingdom.

’Yeah, I have been here once before, so I do know a few things about it.’ Yasmine said calmly before continuing: "The place that you just saw crowded by young men is a competition venue. All the young men across the kingdom come there to get rankings from various academies.

But just now it was a bit too crowded—maybe something big is going on. Anyway, as I had said before, that 1st ranked stone isn’t too rare, and they are often given as gifts to the winners. But the empty ones are indeed a little rare, so it depends on your luck."
’I see...’ Vritra nodded. He decided to check it out, but then he asked: "Do you know where the temple is?"
"Yes, I do. Do you want to go there first to look for my cute mother-in-law?" Yasmine asked.

’Yeah, let’s go there first. There is a high chance they might have gone to the temple, as Diana said that it was sort of a program planned by the two temples.’ Vritra answered while tapping on his chin with the paper fan.
"Okay, let’s head there then."
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]

Vritra flew in the sky again after entering the Fourth Dimension. Then, with a sonic boom, he rushed in the direction Yasmine pointed, and within seconds saw the high tip of the temple. It actually looked quite similar to the temple he used to live in—but even bigger and more majestic.

Vritra arrived near the temple in only a few seconds. Not wanting to get noticed by the legion-ranked men, he landed discreetly before blending in with the crowd, as he began walking towards the temple.

Poor Vritra was unknowingly being pulled into another troubling matter. It wasn’t for nothing that he was called a trouble magnet, after all. How could a kingdom stay peaceful after the emerging Demon Lord had made his way inside it?
But who would have expected that in less than one hour of entering the Blue Kingdom, he was already about to make contact with one of the most dangerous creatures?
Vritra calmly made his way up to the castle and stopped right at its entrance. He could sense that Bobby was nearby, so there was a high chance they might have really gone into the temple.

Dozens of men were walking in and out of the temple constantly. There didn’t seem to be anything wrong at first, but as Vritra began walking into the temple, he felt the strange gazes on himself from all around.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +28}
{Sin Point Gained: Stared at +31}
Vritra entered the majestic temple. All the seats of the temple were filled. A pope stood at the front and was reading something from a book, while all the people kept clapping lightly.
"Something is wrong here. I can no longer sense their presence here. Let’s get out first." Yasmine said.
"..." Those strange stares were still coming from all sides, and Vritra had a bad feeling about this temple as well. Something big was definitely going on right there.
Vritra turned around and began to walk back just as calmly, but the smiling pope who had been on the stage a moment ago appeared in front of Vritra just as he had turned.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Surprised +1}
Despite the surprise, Vritra didn’t show any kind of reaction. He took a step to the side and began to walk. But the pope moved faster as he once again stepped in front of Vritra and finally spoke:
"Why don’t you pray as well? It will give you inner peace."
Vritra frowned slightly before replying: "I am an atheist, and I accidentally entered this place. I don’t believe in prayers."
"Is that right? Well, leaving the temple isn’t as easy as entering. Why don’t you just stay for a while? I am sure we can change you." The pope added with the same smiley face that looked creepy.

Yasmine was still trying to figure out what was wrong with these people. Although she had her doubts, she didn’t believe that could be true. This was the temple of the Blue Kingdom, after all. How could those people have reached here?

"No thanks. Now if you’ll excuse me, I don’t want to hit a pope even if I don’t believe in any of this." Vritra could already sense danger from all around. All the people who were seated had turned their heads, and all of them were looking at him with that same creepy smile.
"Hmmm..." The pope observed Vritra’s body carefully. He couldn’t comprehend everything about him for some reason, but his body was a great attraction to the Grieves as a host.

After thinking for a few seconds, the pope seemed to have made up his mind as he spread his hands and asked: "Have you heard of the Grieves? You can obtain unimaginable power—much further than your wildest imagination—"
The pope wanted to lure Vritra away with words first before resorting to force, but Yasmine’s danger meter had started ringing the moment she heard the wordGrieves.
"RUN!!" She said just one word, her voice full of worry. The Grieves are dangerous creatures which could easily take over anyone’s body and live like a parasite—or just replace the host.
Unless there is a big power difference, it was nearly impossible to stop these creatures.
Vritra nodded calmly while hearing the pope’s words. He was already making a plan to escape in his mind.

But just as he was about to leap into the Fourth Dimension, an extremely strong presence fell over the entire temple. The people on the seats instantly sat straight, and the pope seemed to have tensed up a bit.

chapters.title: Chapter 169: V. Arclis
paragraphs: Vritra and the pope looked outside the door at the same time. There, sitting over a white horse and clad in silver armor, seemed to be a knight—but from the patterns over his armor, he didn’t seem to be a guard of the Blue Kingdom.
And just from the faint aura, Vritra had a feeling that he was much stronger than Faceless and Blunder, and might even be stronger than those three demon generals.
"Is there a problem here?" the knight asked in a heavy tone, scanning Vritra and the pope with an emotionless gaze.
"Oh, sir knight, there is absolutely no problem at all, we were just discussing something together," the pope said, his tone meek.
"... Yeah, there is no problem, I was just leaving, right?" Vritra looked at the pope and asked.
"Y- Yes, that’s right." The pope had no choice but to agree under the crushing pressure. He turned around and began walking back.

Vritra walked out of the temple, and when he glanced back, the knight had already disappeared. He too wasted no time as he entered one of the dark alleys and instantly disappeared. He had many questions for Yasmine.

Just as Vritra had expected, the pope had sent a few people behind Vritra to capture him and bring him back. After all, he had heard the wordGrievesfrom their mouths—that alone could put all their lives in danger.
But those people couldn’t locate him anywhere, no matter how long they searched. Their search continued for hours but came out fruitless.
Vritra flew away from there. Feeling a bit intrigued, he asked, "Who was that person? And what are Grieves?"

"That was the protector of the emperor, Han Gratt. I am a little surprised he is here. Maybe the emperor or the empress has come here for the Scarlet Couple Inheritance. Well, that is of little importance to us.

Anyway, the Grieves are unknown creatures. They are very dangerous and can possess any person. Very little is known about them, but they are highly skilled with glyphs," Yasmine explained only a little about those creatures. She didn’t want him to get involved with those things.

Vritra too didn’t ask any further. He clearly sensed Bobby’s presence close to the temple—or maybe it was some sort of guiding hypnosis that directly pulled people inside and got them trapped—but Vritra did not want to get into another dangerous situation like before without increasing his strength.
"But how do I find them? This place is so big, if it’s not the temple they had entered then..." Vritra thought hard about it. Maybe they had gone to a crowded area, just as Vritra had wanted before.
After thinking of this, he landed on the ground and came out of the Fourth Dimension, since it was quite dangerous to fly around even in the disappearing state.

Vritra soon saw carriages on the road. He paid for one of them and began to head towards the competition venue. The coachman was quite talkative, but Vritra paid little attention to him as he carefully observed his surroundings for any possible signs of the Grieves.
The atmosphere inside the temple had really been quite eerie—almost like a horror movie.

After a little over an hour, Vritra arrived at the competition venue. But because of the crowd, they had to stop a little further away from there. Getting out of the carriage, Vritra looked around and saw thousands of young men. There were middle-aged men too, but with their children.

’I wonder what’s going on here. Anyway, even if they are here, how do I find Mom and the others?’ Vritra walked through the crowd and looked around aimlessly. Soon his gaze landed on two people who sat across a large table and seemed to be the announcers.
"Hello, I am searching for someone. Can you make an announcement?" Vritra asked.

"No, we are only here to announce the names of the participants who—" one of the two men instantly rejected, but Vritra slipped a bag of silver coins on the table, which the man stuffed in his pocket fast.
"COUGH. Sure, sure. Since you are asking so nicely, why won’t I do such a small thing? So, what do you want me to announce?" the same man said as he activated an ability of his.
After thinking for a moment, Vritra gave an answer.
"Alright, young man, I will make the best announcement of my life," he said with a wink before standing up and shouting. His voice reverberated over a large distance because of the skill.
"THE THREE LADIES FROM THE DUNSHIRE KINGDOM, V. ARCLIS IS LOOKING FOR YOU. WHEREVER YOU ARE, PLEASE MEET HIM AT THE EAST GATE. I REPEAT, MEET V. ARCLIS AT THE EAST GATE."
He repeated this a few times and then flashed a smile at Vritra before saying, "All done, tell me if you want to announce something else."
Vritra nodded and waited to the side. After a few minutes, he gave some more coins to keep announcing it after every ten minutes.

Around forty minutes had passed, but no one arrived. It seemed they weren’t here after all. Vritra sighed and decided to just check what was going on here now that he had already arrived at the competition venue.
"H- Honey?!!"
Just then, Vritra heard the sweet, familiar voice. He turned and saw his beautiful mother standing there with a smile but tears in her eyes.
Ignoring everything else, she jumped into his arms, embracing him tightly. Burying her face into his chest, she began to cry, clinging to him with all her strength.
Vritra wrapped his arms around her and began to gently caress her head, while speaking in a soft, soothing tone: "I am fine, Mom. Don’t worry. Everything is fine..."
Vanessa didn’t want to separate from him as she held him tightly. While continuing to embrace his mother, Vritra raised his gaze and saw Fiona and Diana standing there.

Fiona was smiling sweetly, extremely happy to reunite with him. She too wanted to hug him but waited to let Vanessa finish first. Diana smiled faintly and nodded at Vritra. Their relation wasn’t as deep just yet, but Diana no longer seemed to possess any ill intention toward him.

Vritra himself felt a lot better as he felt the warmth of his mother. Just a few days ago, he really felt that he might never meet her ever again. All the tension and headache disappeared in an instant. Getting to hold her again like this made him even happier than obtaining several hybrid skills.
"What happened before? S- Suddenly, I couldn’t feel your presence. Are you alright?" Vanessa took a step back and looked him up and down, tears streaking down her cheeks.
"Yes, Mom, I am perfectly fine. That was just an ability of mine. You don’t think I died and returned from the dead, right?" Vritra smiled and asked while wiping away her tears.

"You know how scared I was... Before, at the Sob Labyrinth, and now t- this. I can’t take such s- shocks. Please don’t ever do something like t- that.SobI can’t live without you." Vanessa sobbed as she hugged him again.
"Yes, Mom. I will never make you experience it again. I am sorry. It’s alright now. I love you," Vritra said, closing his eyes and inhaling her sweet, calming scent.
