Anyway, even if they are here, how do I find Mom and the others?’ Vritra walked through the crowd and looked around aimlessly.
Soon his gaze landed on two people who sat across a large table and seemed to be the announcers.
"Hello, I am searching for someone.
Can you make an announcement?" Vritra asked.

"No, we are only here to announce the names of the participants who—" one of the two men instantly rejected, but Vritra slipped a bag of silver coins on the table, which the man stuffed in his pocket fast.
"COUGH.
Sure, sure.
Since you are asking so nicely, why won’t I do such a small thing?
So, what do you want me to announce?" the same man said as he activated an ability of his.
After thinking for a moment, Vritra gave an answer.
"Alright, young man, I will make the best announcement of my life," he said with a wink before standing up and shouting.
His voice reverberated over a large distance because of the skill.
"THE THREE LADIES FROM THE DUNSHIRE KINGDOM, V.
ARCLIS IS LOOKING FOR YOU.
WHEREVER YOU ARE, PLEASE MEET HIM AT THE EAST GATE.
I REPEAT, MEET V.
ARCLIS AT THE EAST GATE."
He repeated this a few times and then flashed a smile at Vritra before saying, "All done, tell me if you want to announce something else."
Vritra nodded and waited to the side.
After a few minutes, he gave some more coins to keep announcing it after every ten minutes.
Around forty minutes had passed, but no one arrived.
It seemed they weren’t here after all.
Vritra sighed and decided to just check what was going on here now that he had already arrived at the competition venue.
"H- Honey?!!"
Just then, Vritra heard the sweet, familiar voice.
He turned and saw his beautiful mother standing there with a smile but tears in her eyes.
Ignoring everything else, she jumped into his arms, embracing him tightly.
Burying her face into his chest, she began to cry, clinging to him with all her strength.
Vritra wrapped his arms around her and began to gently caress her head, while speaking in a soft, soothing tone: "I am fine, Mom.
Don’t worry.
Everything is fine..."
Vanessa didn’t want to separate from him as she held him tightly.
While continuing to embrace his mother, Vritra raised his gaze and saw Fiona and Diana standing there.
Fiona was smiling sweetly, extremely happy to reunite with him.
She too wanted to hug him but waited to let Vanessa finish first.
Diana smiled faintly and nodded at Vritra.
Their relation wasn’t as deep just yet, but Diana no longer seemed to possess any ill intention toward him.
Vritra himself felt a lot better as he felt the warmth of his mother.
Just a few days ago, he really felt that he might never meet her ever again.
All the tension and headache disappeared in an instant.
Getting to hold her again like this made him even happier than obtaining several hybrid skills.
"What happened before?
S- Suddenly, I couldn’t feel your presence.
Are you alright?" Vanessa took a step back and looked him up and down, tears streaking down her cheeks.
"Yes, Mom, I am perfectly fine.
That was just an ability of mine.
You don’t think I died and returned from the dead, right?" Vritra smiled and asked while wiping away her tears.
"You know how scared I was...
Before, at the Sob Labyrinth, and now t- this.
I can’t take such s- shocks.
Please don’t ever do something like t- that.SobI can’t live without you." Vanessa sobbed as she hugged him again.
"Yes, Mom.
I will never make you experience it again.
I am sorry.
It’s alright now.
I love you," Vritra said, closing his eyes and inhaling her sweet, calming scent.

chapters.title: Chapter 170: Marriage Trial
paragraphs: Vritra, Diana, Fiona, and Vanessa sat inside a well-packed hotel and ordered some food for themselves. Vritra was holding his mother’s hand with his right and Fiona’s with his left. The two women were overjoyed after reuniting with him.
"Did you not go to the temple?" Vritra asked, remembering the strange and eerie place.

"We did go to the temple, after all, we knew that would be the first place you would go to search for us. But after arriving in front of the temple, I had an ominous feeling there. In the end, we didn’t go in and came to the second most likely place for you to visit—the most crowded area." Diana was the one to answer.
"Sir, here is your food." The young waiter brought the food to their table, staring in awe at the three beautiful women and looking at Vritra with jealousy.

"You did good. I indeed went to the temple, and something is certainly wrong with that place. None of you should go anywhere near it," Vritra said seriously. The three women had booked three rooms in a hotel and had stayed there for a few days while waiting for Vritra.
"The people who were following us, are they still after us? A-And what about that news we heard... the demon lord Vritra? Are they all talking about you?" Vanessa asked in a worried tone.

"I don’t think they will be able to follow us for a while. As for that news—yeah, they are indeed talking about me. But this news was spread by the exact same people who were following us," Vritra replied. He decided not to reveal the truth just yet—it was too big of a change after all.
Although Vritra was sure that Vanessa would accept him no matter how he changed, he wanted to break the news in a better situation and not rush it.

"Ah, just who were the people that were following us? They even killed the king. Can’t we just complain about it to someone? Anyone?" Fiona asked in frustration. She, too, had heard why Vanessa had fainted earlier, and just the thought made her incredibly sad.

"We can’t trust anyone here. Even if they seem to be the pillar of justice itself, don’t ever reveal anything to them. This place is not Earth," Vritra warned, looking at his mother and Fiona. Then he looked at Diana.

His score with the goddess hadn’t been settled properly yet. She had tried to kill him before, after all, so she needed a lot of training to bring her out of her comfort zone. He couldn’t just let go of someone who almost killed him.
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +1}
"Don’t worry, I won’t say a word about anything to anyone," Diana spoke in a hurry, feeling his gaze on her.
"It’s not that you won’t, but that you just can’t. The moment you try anything, your soul will be destroyed," Vritra said directly. He didn’t care about her reputation or anything.
"Anyway, how did you change your appearance so much? I really couldn’t recognize you," Vanessa asked, changing the subject.
"It’s because of a skill of mine. I can change my appearance however I want," Vritra answered as his expression changed the moment he looked at his mother.

They chatted and ate the warm food. After gulping a mouthful of soup, Vritra raised his gaze and asked, "Do any of you know what’s happening here? That’s a big crowd. I don’t think some normal competition is happening here, right?"

"Yes, it’s indeed not a normal competition. Only a little is revealed to the public, but from what I heard, in this competition, out of thousands of young men, only one would be selected." Fiona began to explain, gazing at him with love and tenderness.

"That’s a rather high rejection rate. Just what exactly are they competing for?" Vritra asked in surprise. Thousands of young men from all over the Blue Kingdom had gathered there, after all, and selecting just one out of them all—it had to be something big.

"Yeah. The winner of the competition will get the chance to participate in some sort of marriage trial. Not much information is given in that regard, but the girl is said to be some relative of the emperor. That’s why so many young men have gathered," Fiona added. Her voice was full of awe as well while gazing at Vritra.

"Despite defeating thousands of other competitors and winning the competition, the winner will only get the chance to participate in a girl’s marriage trial? That sounds quite absurd. Anyway, that’s not important. Is there any other reward for the winner?"
Fiona felt happy as she saw Vritra show absolutely no interest in that unknown girl—unlike all the other men who were chasing after that status and a lifetime of money and resources.
"Yeah, I did hear about a few rewards, like one armor and weapon at the peak of the 1st Legion rank, and..." Diana began to answer after calming down. Then she continue:

"The winner will also get a 1st Legion ranked stone based on the field of the winner. Though if the winner is already in the Legion rank, then that reward could be changed with something of equal value."
"Oh, a Legion Stone, huh. That’s a nice reward." Vritra finally felt some interest in the competition. Not to mention, he was lacking a nice armor and the axes’ level needed to be increased.
"Are you going to participate in the competition?" Vanessa asked, putting more food onto Vritra’s plate.
"Diana, how much do you know about this kingdom? Do you think there is any other place to obtain an empty 1st ranked Legion Stone?" Vritra asked after thinking for a moment.
"The Legion Stones could indeed be obtained in some shops, but empty Stones most probably won’t be available there. Other than that, maybe in some auction..." Diana answered, thinking hard about it.
"Then I guess I will have to participate in the competition. That marriage trial or whatever doesn’t matter, but the other rewards are nice," Vritra said. A new armor could be really helpful.
"Yes, yes! You definitely should participate in this competition, young master Jin Woo," a ragged voice sounded from the side. The three women looked at the battered Baldy Monk in surprise.
Vritra had already sensed the presence of the biggest living jinx, the harbinger of bad luck, as he walked into the hotel.
"Sigh. And what are you doing here?" Vritra asked. He didn’t want to stay in too close of a proximity with this Monk.
"Hehe, after I managed to get rid of all those guards by making them follow my bullo, I came here directly since I knew you would be here. And guess what?

I also knew that you are definitely going to participate in that competition, so I already got your name registered in the competition. No one is more fit to become the husband of—" Monk began to speak in a flattering tone, sensing that Vritra was about to shoo him away.

"You registered my name, huh. So when is this competition starting, and what do you know about it all? I saw the emperor’s protector earlier. Was he also here because of this competition or something else?" Vritra asked several questions at once.

chapters.title: Chapter 171: Blessing of Buddha
paragraphs: "The competition will start tomorrow morning. All the registrations were already finished—it is only because of my strong connections that I was able to register your name," Monk Shitless said proudly before continuing.

"The protector of the Emperor you met before—I believe he is here with either the Emperor or the Empress. He won’t leave the Emperor’s side otherwise. As for the competition, I don’t know much either, aside from the marriage trial and the rewards. Oh, and the age restriction is set at twenty-five."
"Okay, did you get a badge or something when signing me up?" Vritra asked. He doubted just such a short interaction with this Monk could bring him any bad luck.

"Yes, pitiful one, I did. Here—your number is 23,008. Yes, there will be more than twenty thousand participants and even more people watching as audience. So, isn’t this the type of event you would like?" Monk Shitless said. He didn’t know why Vritra liked crowded places so much, but more people equaled more chaos—and how could the Monk miss that?
Vritra took the badge and after a look, he put it away, then nodded at the Monk as a sign of thank you and also as a silent gesture asking him to leave.

Monk Shitless grinned as he turned around and began walking, but his shoulder accidentally bumped into a man who lost his balance and fell over the next table, directly putting his face into burning hot soup.
"Aaaaaaah! You damned—ughhh—Baldy! Cough cough—I’m going to kill you! Uwaaa—my eyesssss..."
"It’s the blessing of the buddha, aaah I am innocent." Monk Shitless ran like an arrow being released from a bow, as the other guy ran behind him.
"..." Vritra shook his head and looked back at the three women.

"I will be participating in the competition tomorrow as you all already know. You three should hide among the audience—and start wearing veils. You’re associated with that demon news after all. Also, where have you been staying?" Vritra asked.

"We have booked our rooms in a nearby hotel. Let’s stay there. Oh right—here, you can have your friends back," Vanessa said, handing Zengis back to Vritra. At the same time, Bobby also flew out of her shadow, directly jumping into his palm.
"Oh, it seems they kept you safe." Vritra chuckled as he caressed Zengis and Bobby. Then he put Zengis away and gave Bobby back to his mother—the three needed it more than he did for now.

"Let’s go." He stood up and along with Vanessa and the others walked out of there after paying their bill. The outside was as lively as ever. Young men seemed to be full of hope as if they were going to be the real winner and future husband of whoever the lady was.

But Vritra could sense a few Legion-ranked young men among them, whose ages were between twenty and twenty-five. All these young men were most probably from powerful families, and with enough support, they reached such a high level at such a young age.
’Can I defeat Legion-ranked without using the Demon Lord’s core? Well, I have many other skills... but the problem is I can’t reveal too much—and I also have to defeat such strong people.’

Vritra sighed, but although these people had reached Legion rank because of the support of their families, they barely had any real experience. And because of the tenderness they had received, they wouldn’t encounter fortunate treasures.

While thinking about the next day’s battle, Vritra walked toward the hotel along with the three. The weather was a bit hot, and it was around two in the afternoon. Vritra didn’t have much to do for the day, so he decided to spend the day with the three women.
After entering the hotel, Diana went into her room while Fiona glanced at Vritra before going into her own, and Vritra followed Vanessa into her room.

The two talked for a while. Vanessa was still shaken by the event a few days ago. Vritra hugged his "mother" as the two lay on the bed. Finally, in his arms, she felt truly comforted. Glancing at his face, she asked:
"Can you show me your real face now?"
Vritra nodded as his face instantly began to change.
[Intra Shuffle Activated!!]
Soon Vritra’s real face appeared—the one after he had transformed into a demon. He felt this was the right moment to tell the secret to his "mother," so two horns also appeared over his head.
Vanessa sat up straight in surprise as she saw his face, which seemed to have changed once again—but the two horns above his head were the most striking change.
"Wait, are these real? Then the news about—" Vanessa asked, her mouth forming an O shape.

"Yeah, that’s right. Somehow, I indeed became a demon," Vritra answered. He didn’t jump to the other side willingly—it’s just how things ended. But he wasn’t really complaining about it, since his strength had increased by so much.
"Woah, you look so handsome—so... so bewitching." Vanessa stared at him, then she raised her finger and touched Vritra’s cheek before caressing it with her palms.

"Such tender skin... it’s like I’m touching you when you were little. Can I touch those horns? They look so cool and suit you a lot!!" Vanessa asked excitedly—and without waiting for his answer, she touched his black horns. She couldn’t deny he looked devilishly handsome.
Vanessa didn’t care a bit that he was a demon or not. All that mattered was that he was her son, and the beliefs of the world could go to sewage for all she cared—she loved him more than anything.
She cupped his cheek and gently pressed her moist lips against his, and just stayed there, savoring the warmth and softness they both felt.
Then she pulled back, her eyes seeming to glow with a pink hue as she spoke in a seductive tone:
"I love you. You will always be mine. No matter how you transform, we will never be apart."

Vritra smiled. He was sure of Vanessa’s love, but still felt a bit unsure how she would react to such a huge change. But his heart was filled with warmth as she gazed at him with such an intense expression.
Using the dust, Vritra closed the window’s covers while Yasmine covered the room with a layer of barrier, as Vanessa climbed on top of him.
It was time for the training.

She sat over his waist then leaned forward, taking his lips into hers into a passionate kiss. Unlike the earlier soft kiss this was a rather wild one, as if all their feelings and lust had exploded at the same time.

"Mmmm~" their lips slid over one another, Vanessa pushed her soft pink tongue into his mouth, moving it all over his mouth. She licked everywhere before her tongue became entangled with his, rolling over a mess of saliva, as the two sucked one another’s mouth.
Their hands rubbed over each other’s body, Vanessa began to remove his clothes hurriedly, looking as if she was in heat.
While Vritra just tore her clothes apart as if they were made of paper, he broke the bra as her heavy and soft breasts landed over his chest, pressing softly and spreading across his skin.

paragraphs: Vritra and Fiona walked out of the hotel, they passed through the street hand in hand and soon arrived in the market.
The two were instantly surprised by the huge crowd there, as if some big celebrity was passing by. There weren’t only young men now—the crowd filled the large streets and spread over a vast distance.

"Hmm, is it also because of the competition? It doesn’t look like that though, is someone important entering the kingdom?" Vritra mumbled to himself. He walked along the crowded road and the two halted at a place where the crowd was a bit thin.
Vritra looked at one of the overly excited middle-aged men and asked: "What’s going on here?"

"Haven’t you heard yet? The Empress is coming into our kingdom!! Can you believe that, the human Empress herself will be coming here and I will be able to see her!!" the man wearing a suit spoke as if every wish of his life had been fulfilled.
"The human Empress?" Vritra asked. He did hear Yasmine and Monk Shitless mention her, but his knowledge about this world was still quite limited.
But seeing the crowd, Vritra had a strong urge to jump into the air and shout to get everyone’s attention. That would give him so many sin points instantly—but this was not the right time.
The Blue Kingdom was too dangerous at this time, so it was better not to get too much attention. Even Daddy V probably won’t come out during the competition.

"Yes, I had heard she is extremely beautiful. The second most beautiful woman alive in the entire world, even the ’Emperor’—the strongest human alive—had to use all his abilities, connections and whatnot to finally win her heart and get engaged to her. But I had heard some rumors..." The man in the suit looked to the left and right before whispering to Vritra.

"I had heard the Empress has no interest in marrying the Emperor, that is why even though they got engaged more than five years ago they never got married. The Empress is very cold, brutal, emotionless and has absolutely no feelings—she kills anyone without second thoughts.

She is like the most beautiful fire, but if you get even a little close, you will end up getting burnt to death. Sigh... that cold personality, that feeling that no one could obtain her, that is what makes her even more attractive.

The Emperor loves her too much though, he even sent his personal protector for her and surrounded the entire Blue Kingdom. No one is allowed to enter now." The middle-aged man just continued to speak.
But Vritra did get a few useful pieces of info out of that. After a moment he asked in his mind:
’Wifey, what do you think about this all?’

"Looks like the Scarlet Couple inheritance is about to open or maybe it already is, and the Empress wants to restrict such a great treasure for herself using the Emperor’s power. I had met her before, she is indeed quite violent and a bit weaker than me.

It would be better if you don’t get involved with her. She would think later and kill first—a madwoman. Love holds absolutely no value for her. But the Emperor is crazy for her, you won’t believe how much he had to do just to get engaged with that emotionless woman.

She would do anything to achieve her goal, that’s why despite not being in love with the Emperor she agreed to get engaged to him after a deal they made. Oh right, she hates demons with all her heart." Yasmine explained, remembering that violent woman.

Vritra looked at the middle-aged man and decided to ask the most important thing he found in all his speech: "If the Empress is the second most beautiful woman, then who is the first? And I heard the Dragon Queen is also very beautiful."

"... I don’t know. I have only heard about her being the second. As for the Dragon Queen, well, she is long dead—but yeah she shared the second position with the Empress before. She was also extremely beautiful." The middle-aged man said, before focusing on the road.

"Let’s leave." Vritra looked at Fiona and spoke. He didn’t have any interest in the Empress nor the Scarlet Inheritance—both are too dangerous. It was better to just let his strength grow in a bit more safe environment. He would die with just a flick of a finger from the people of the Empress’s level.
It was a pity that he couldn’t get it, but life is more important in the end.

"Wait, I want to see what the Empress looks like. I had heard she is very strong, and the only woman who can even make the Emperor lose his composure. Can we wait a bit longer?" Fiona asked with curiosity in her eyes. She gave him a puppy look.

Vritra was aware of his bad luck—he would end up getting involved in the most deadly situations just by being present there—so he did want to leave, but after looking at her cute face he felt that there shouldn’t be any problem.
"Fine, let’s wait and see." Vritra nodded and patted her head, as Fiona hugged him in joy and gave a peck on his lips.

She wasn’t flying too fast nor too slow. All the people could only get one look before she passed by them, but the people seemed to have gone mad just from that one sight.
After a minute, the Empress flew through the path in front of Vritra and Fiona. The Empress was uninterestedly looking at her surroundings, scanning the crowd of thousands with just a casual look.

Then he made his way along with the others into the large coliseum after a short walk from the gate. They were in a large hall with countless seats placed all over it.

The place did seem a little crowded since there were more than twenty thousand men, but there were a lot of seats still empty since most of the young men were too excited to sit. They all felt that they were the chosen ones and would definitely be the winner.

Vritra sat on a seat, patiently waiting for the start of the competition while chatting with his naughty wife. Glancing to the side, Vritra noticed a boy who seemed to be stuffed with extremely expensive and precious accessories—lots of rings, armor, and much more.
Sensing Vritra’s gaze, the other boy smiled brightly and extended his right hand while speaking: "Nice to meet you, I am Rich."

sentences.text: The empress was in a red dress, her figure looking graceful with such perfect curves.
Her face was hidden behind a veil, but what little bit of her skin was visible looked creamy and beautiful like jade.
The empress’s long blue hair swayed in the air as she flew through the protective walls of countless guards.
She swept her gaze through the crowd, but at one point her gaze lingered on someone a second longer before she continued to fly forward.
In the crowd, Vritra tensed up as the empress’s blue pupils locked onto him for just an instant.
He only relaxed after she had moved a bit further away.
A cold and deadly aura did seem to linger around her body.
Vritra barely got to see her because of his nervousness before she flew away.
"W- Whoa!!
Did you just see that?
The empress just looked at me, I- I am shivering, I can’t believe this.
This is the greatest moment of my life!!" the middle-aged man next to Vritra was going crazy as he shouted and jumped.
"Let’s go now." Vritra said, as he led Fiona out of the crowd.
She could feel that he seemed to be tensed up because of something, and she gave a light squeeze to his hand and smiled.
’I knew it, even standing there was a bad decision.
Wifey, do you think she found out that I am a demon?
Did she see through my disguise?’ Vritra asked.
There was no way he could fight someone of her level just yet.
"Sigh, I knew it, you indeed are a trouble magnet, hubby.
She most probably didn’t know that you are a demon or you might already be dead.
But you did attract her attention, maybe she saw through your disguise, but since you have a dragon bloodline she didn’t recognize you.
Anyway, it’s better that we got out of that much easier than I thought.

I guess she will be going to get the inheritance now, and after that, she will just leave this kingdom, so I don’t think we will even see her again." Yasmine said in a pondering tone, but she couldn’t have been more wrong about the last part.
Vritra and Fiona decided to check out a sweets shop.
He already relaxed because of Yasmine’s words and his redhead lover’s soothing presence.
They walked around the market, and Fiona even bought several things like clothes, accessories, jewelry, and so on.
They spent a few hours together.
All the people were only talking about the empress.
They even seemed to have forgotten about the competition that would be taking place the next day.
They bought food for everyone and returned to the hotel as it began to turn dark.
Then all of them gathered in Vanessa’s room and began to eat together.
"Did you two see the empress?
I heard there was a big commotion outside." Diana asked, eyes full of curiosity.
"Yeah, we saw her fly earlier.
She appears as charming as the rumors say, there was something special about her presence.
No wonder she caught the attention of the man who rules over all humans, all the kingdoms and continents." Fiona said, remembering the moment when she saw the empress.
"..." Vritra didn’t even want to remember that scene.
For a moment he really felt she was about to rush toward him and kill him right there.
The three continued to talk for a while, then Fiona and Diana returned to their rooms as it got late, while Vritra stayed with Vanessa.
The pair of mother and son slept together, finding comfort in each other’s arms.
As dawn broke, the streets became crowded though nowhere near as much as the previous day.
Still, thousands of young men were rushing towards the competition venue.
Their families were coming along to support them and watch them fight.
The competition won’t end in a single day since there were just too many participants.
On the first day, the highest number of participants would be eliminated.
Only around a thousand would be left out of more than twenty thousand young men.
Then the competition would continue for a few more days until they get a final winner.
Vritra walked beside the three gorgeous women, all of whom were wearing veils but still looked radiantly beautiful.
He kept getting sin points from all the men who were envious of him, especially the young folks.
The group of four made their way towards the large competition venue.
It was being held in a large arena—or it rather seemed to be a coliseum.
The spectators were heading inside through the first gate, so Vritra separated from the three women there, who entered the coliseum and took seats somewhere in the middle.
Vritra walked towards the second gate which was being used for the participants.
The line there seemed just as long as the spectators.
Strong young men from all over the Blue Kingdom seemed to have arrived there—who would want to miss such a huge chance, after all?
Vritra joined the line silently.
Because of his handsome face he was still getting quite a bit of sin points, but he didn’t do anything to stand out too much.
It was better to lay low for some time, though if he could win the competition he would receive plenty of limelight.
The participants quickly entered the coliseum after showing their badge.
Vritra took out his own badge and stuck it to his clothes over his chest.
"Name?" the people doing the entry at the entrance asked.
The security and preparation for this competition seemed quite high, each participant had to answer several people before they were allowed to enter.
"Jin Woo." Vritra answered, as his turn came.
"Level?"
"999." He answered honestly, since there was no point in hiding.
There were even men at Legion rank.
Instead, if he lied about his level and then won against every fighter with his low level, he would look even more suspicious.
"Age?" the man writing in a register asked.
He didn’t seem the least bit surprised upon hearing that high level.
Instead, he seemed to believe that Vritra was the son from some well-off and powerful family.
That was why his level was high.
"19." Came the answer.
After a few more questions were asked by different people, Vritra finally entered through the large gate.
Then he made his way along with the others into the large coliseum after a short walk from the gate.
They were in a large hall with countless seats placed all over it.
The place did seem a little crowded since there were more than twenty thousand men, but there were a lot of seats still empty since most of the young men were too excited to sit.

chapters.title: Chapter 175: Groups
paragraphs: "Nice to meet you, I am Rich." The guy who seemed to be around twenty years old extended his hand towards Vritra and said with a polite smile.
"Hello." Vritra shook hands with the strange guy. From his baby face to his attitude, he seemed like a guy from a well-off family, and he was even in the legion rank.

Vritra glanced at his equipment, which seemed much better than the prize promised from the competition. Though this guy stood out the most in the crowd, Vritra decided to mind his own business as he lost himself in his thoughts.

’Sigh, it feels so bad that I can’t get that scarlet couple inheritance. Even that map will go to waste. The empress will be the one to get it, she isn’t even letting anyone else enter. I wonder what kind of treasure is hidden inside.’ Vritra shook his head. He wondered if he should just throw that map away, but then he decided not to. It’s not like it was taking any extra space.
"Are you interest— cough— interested in marrying that mystery girl?" Rich spoke, getting flustered for a moment before composing himself.
"Not really, I am here for the other rewards. What about you?" Vritra decided to pass the little time by talking to him since Rich started the conversation.
"Huh? How could I marry my— cough—I mean, no, I am not here to marry her." Rich said. He seemed a bit flustered upon hearing that question.
"And it doesn’t look like you are here for the other reward, so are you here just for entertainment?" Vritra asked. He was getting a strange feeling from how the other person kept panicking.
It seemed this boy knew who the girl was going to be, but Vritra had no interest in any of this.

"Haha, yeah, I just came to watch everything closely." Rich said. Just because of his equipment, none of the people present in the large hall would be able to hurt him, not even Vritra—of course, unless he decided to harm himself along with him.
They chatted a bit longer, as Rich pointed towards various participants who seemed likely to win and would be a good match for the marriage trial.

"Looks like this guy is related to the mystery girl, but I can tell from just one look—he would even be scared to kill a fly, so his family must have forced him to finish off injured strong demons. That’s how he even got to the legion rank." Yasmine said. She could tell that at least he was a boy, not some girl in hiding.
After a while, several kingdom guards entered the large hall. After making sure that no one important was left to enter, they began to announce: "Everyone, stop talking and focus here."
The hall suddenly quieted down as the excited group of young men listened carefully to the announcement. After a short and imposing pose, the head guard began to speak:

"There are more than twenty thousand participants, and more than ninety-nine percent of you are failures. The competition will be held over several days. Today, you all will be divided into two groups—both groups with nearly the same number of members.
Members of each group will be made to fight one another, and out of more than ten thousand participants in the group, only around five hundred will be selected for the next round."
Everyone in the hall was surprised by the large failure rate. Now they looked around, and sensing the auras of a very few legion-ranked young men, they suddenly lost all confidence.

"Now those of you with long faces, I can tell all of you are nothing more than trash. So instead of wasting our time, why don’t you just walk out of that door on your own and save some of your parents’ dignity? You don’t want to die so young, right?" the head guard added, and even more people were scared now. Of course, they didn’t want to die.
After hearing that, more than a thousand young men meekly walked out of the hall. Despite their desires, they were aware of their own strength, after all.
"Sigh, there are so many delusional fools. Anyway, up to the serial number eleven thousand would be the first group and the remaining would be in the second group.

Now, the first group follow behind me to the arena. It will be a free fight with the only rule being to not kill. Other than that, you will be responsible for yourself." the rude head guard said before he turned around and began to walk out of the hall.
The participants up to number eleven thousand hastily followed behind the head guard. Vritra sighed that he would have to wait for so long and now he was just wasting time sitting here.
"How long do you think the fight outside would last?" Vritra looked at Rich and asked.
"Hmm, should be at least three hours, though it might stretch out for even longer." Rich replied. He had been in a few other such competitions after all—the competitions for marriage trials.

’What a wastage of time. There are more than ten thousand people here, so why not earn some sin points? Of course, without becoming the public enemy or gathering the wrong attention towards himself.’ Vritra thought as he stood up. Then he walked towards one of the walls and shouted in a loud voice:
"HEY EVERYONE, LISTEN HERE! I HAVE A GREAT ADVICE FOR YOU ALL. IF YOU FOLLOW, YOU JUST MIGHT BECOME ONE OF THOSE FIVE HUNDRED PEOPLE!!"
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +11,438}
{Sin Point Gained: Annoyed +6,566}
{Sin Point Gained: Intrigued +6,448}
Instantly, waves of sin points poured out. There were people always keeping an eye on everyone in the hall so Vritra couldn’t do anything extreme, but forming a team was a normal thing.
"What are you talking about? How can you guarantee that we become the five hundred inners?"
"Are you trying to trick us? Who is he even?"
Along with the waves of questions from all sides, the sin points kept coming rapidly. Vritra waited for a few seconds before speaking again:

"No, I guarantee you, if you follow what I say, then you will absolutely win this one. I only need four hundred ninety-nine of you. We will form a group together and thrash away all the other participants. Do you think the other individuals would dare to attack a group as big as ours?"

Hearing his words, everyone paused. There really seemed logic behind those words. They looked at one another. Many were confident enough in themselves that they would become winners even without anyone’s help, but most didn’t have much confidence.

After a slight pause, hundreds of the young men rushed forward towards Vritra. That few lines from him made a big change in the competition. Vritra selected exactly 499 members, and Rich was also in his group. Sin points were constantly rushing in, and Vritra had achieved his goal already.

But seeing the group of five hundred, the other underconfident young men also decided to form groups. In the end, sixteen groups, each having up to five hundred members, were formed, while the rest still wanted to fight on their own. Vritra was getting sin points by just standing there.

chapters.title: Chapter 176: Tactic
paragraphs: The battle of the first batch lasted a little over five hours, hundreds of the participants got badly injured and a group of five hundred were selected in the end.
Now it was time for the second batch to go into the arena, but the audience who were cheering loudly even after hours of shouting were surprised when the next batch walked onto the arena.
Most of the participants seemed to be wearing different coloured clothes on their right arms, this was the solution they came up with so they didn’t end up hurting their own group.
Vritra was the leader of Team Red. Out of the sixteen groups, his group stood out a bit more—the members there were selected first, so they were better than the others.
As they climbed onto the arena, sixteen groups took their parts of the stage and stood in a systematic way.

While the group which didn’t choose any side stood on the opposite side, people talked in awe at the strange behaviour of this batch. The previous ones just fought like barbarians; there were small groups, but nothing as systematic as this.
"Hello young people, I am the host and announcer of your battle. My name is ’TK’ and I will make this announcement again.

You are not allowed to kill others, this is not a fight to the death. If you kill others then not only will you be out of this competition but will be arrested as well." TK warned, then he continued in a relaxed tone:
"Now this batch seems much more promising and smart than the previous one, do your best and win.
Every person who wins today will be rewarded with gold and have priority when applying as guards for the castle. Let’s not bore our spectators anymore, and the battle begins!!"

There was complete silence for a few seconds on the arena and the audience seats, then chaos broke out. Vritra had already informed his group about their plan. He divided the members into distant damage dealers, tanks, and direct fighters.

The tanks took their positions at the front. Activating their skills, they would take the brunt of the first wave of attack from other groups, while the group would launch attacks at others from the distance—a simple but effective strategy.
"GUARD!!" Vritra’s voice thundered the most across the entire coliseum. Even the spectators felt their blood boil at his fighting spirit.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +36,937}
{Sin Point Gained: Awed +28,083}
{Sin Point Gained: Praised +34,837}
The speed at which the messages refreshed increased as sin points flooded wildly. This was the highest amount he had gotten in such a short time.

All the members of Team Red let out a roar as the tanks activated their skills and covered the entire group in a large barrier. Even the other groups were shocked by their perfect teamwork and cooperation.

Most among the other groups weren’t even able to choose a leader, and those that did weren’t able to achieve this level of teamwork. So they all wondered how Vritra achieved so much in such a short time.

Vritra was planning to use a bit of his dust ability. As his skill was leveling up, it was getting extremely terrifying and unique—but at the earlier levels it wasn’t too different from Earth abilities, so others wouldn’t even be able to relate him with the emerging Demon Lord.
"LOCK!!" Another shout from Vritra made everyone even more excited. The sin points were coming like crazy, and he wasn’t standing out too much in the wrong way.

The distant dealers all began to lock their targets in the direction Vritra pointed, as they activated their skills and waited for the next command. At first, they too didn’t want him to lead since there seemed to be a few members stronger than him, but just a few words from Vritra made them understand that he was the best leader for them.

It isn’t true that the strongest leader would always bring victory to his team, but a smart leader would never let defeat come their way. Having a strong leader might scare the other side a bit, but when the entire group becomes one, then the other side wouldn’t even know how they were defeated.
{Sin Point Gained: Praised +34,247}
{Sin Point Gained: Looked up to +30,875}
{Sin Point Gained: Envied +6,039}
"ATTACK!!" The groups were truly baffled by the teamwork. They messily put up their guards—the tanks of their teams were randomly scattered across the group, which created several loopholes.
No one had thought that Vritra would lead his group so well. Even his own team was surprised by their leader and their teamwork. They could almost see the victory in their hands.
Skills upon skills were activated at the same time and then they were shot towards the group standing the closest to the Red group.
BOOOM
BANNGGG BOOOOM

Explosions rang out across the whole colosseum. More than two hundred men of the other group were instantly eliminated as they fainted upon getting hit. Mostly the tanks of the other group remained, and their overall strength had decreased by more than fifty percent.
The other groups were too busy fighting among themselves, so many didn’t notice this scene. The White team was already on the verge of collapsing after a single strike.
"AIM!!" Vritra called out. He had already instructed that after the first strike, the second one needed to be more precise—they needed to eliminate as many tanks as possible.

So inside the large group of five hundred young men, fifty teams were formed with around five members in each, consisting of the distant damage dealers. Each team selected a single tank from the other side to bombard him with attacks.

"ATTACK!!" Vritra commanded as waves after waves of attacks were launched. The tanks could hold on against two- or three- people’s attacks, but against five people with similar or higher levels, they had absolutely no chance.
BOOOM BOOOM BOOOM

Explosion upon explosion sounded as one after the other, the tanks of the White teams were defeated. In less than a minute, more than four hundred members of the other team were on the ground and unable to fight.
By the end of three minutes, only one legion-ranked fighter remained, while all the others were taken care of.
"Rest and recharge," Vritra said as the attackers began to drink potions to fill their mana reserves. Then he added: "Legion rank!!"
There were two legion-ranked fighters in his own team. The two were impressed by this young guy, so they followed Vritra’s words without any complaints.
"Can you take care of him?" Vritra asked, while using his dust ability constantly to attack others in the distance.
"Of course, leave him to us. He is no match for the both of us." The two tapped over their chests and spoke confidently before rushing forward.

Vritra observed their fight for a few seconds, and seeing that the other person was about to lose, he began to observe the whole battlefield—choosing his next target while feeling excited at getting so many passive points without inviting any trouble.
Maybe soon he would be able to upgrade one or two of his skills. Just the thought made him excited.

He had already instructed that after the first strike, the second one needed to be more precise—they needed to eliminate as many tanks as possible.
So inside the large group of five hundred young men, fifty teams were formed with around five members in each, consisting of the distant damage dealers.
Each team selected a single tank from the other side to bombard him with attacks.
"ATTACK!!" Vritra commanded as waves after waves of attacks were launched.
The tanks could hold on against two- or three- people’s attacks, but against five people with similar or higher levels, they had absolutely no chance.
BOOOM BOOOM BOOOM
Explosion upon explosion sounded as one after the other, the tanks of the White teams were defeated.
In less than a minute, more than four hundred members of the other team were on the ground and unable to fight.
By the end of three minutes, only one legion-ranked fighter remained, while all the others were taken care of.
"Rest and recharge," Vritra said as the attackers began to drink potions to fill their mana reserves.
Then he added: "Legion rank!!"
There were two legion-ranked fighters in his own team.
The two were impressed by this young guy, so they followed Vritra’s words without any complaints.
"Can you take care of him?" Vritra asked, while using his dust ability constantly to attack others in the distance.
"Of course, leave him to us.
He is no match for the both of us." The two tapped over their chests and spoke confidently before rushing forward.

Vritra observed their fight for a few seconds, and seeing that the other person was about to lose, he began to observe the whole battlefield—choosing his next target while feeling excited at getting so many passive points without inviting any trouble.
Maybe soon he would be able to upgrade one or two of his skills.
Just the thought made him excited.

paragraphs: The White team was eliminated quickly. Everyone in the audience was shocked by how efficiently they worked—five hundred people were defeated so easily, while the other groups were fighting each other just like how people in the previous batch fought.
Vritra then decided to take it a bit slow. If the other sides were defeated too fast, then he wouldn’t be able to get too many sin points. He looked back at his team and announced:
"Our next target will be the winner between the Blue and Green team. Take as much rest as you all can for the next few minutes."

Vanessa, Fiona, and Diana watched Vritra’s performance from the seats. They never thought he could be such a good leader; he had always been more of a loner, after all. But it seemed he was much more talented than they thought.

The other groups fought hard. At one point, it became so messy that no one cared if it was a person from their own team—they attacked anyone close to them. Most of the groups had already been disbanded. Vritra just stood there calmly and farmed the free sin points.

After a little over ten minutes had passed, the other groups and participants finally began to notice the Red group, which seemed as if they hadn’t even fought a bit, while all the others were already getting exhausted.

"GUARD!!" Just as several people charged towards them, Vritra gave a command. Only around a hundred or so people were charging at them—it seemed they wanted to eliminate the leader first. But all the attackers were instantly locked by the distant damage dealers.
"ATTACK!!" Vritra said as hundreds of attacks were launched at the same time. Those attackers stood absolutely no chance and got knocked off.

Vritra decided to slowly eliminate the other group. He gestured for the group to follow behind him as he gave different commands based on the situation, and the members mindlessly followed all his commands.

No matter how the enemy attacked, they could never go past their defense and were always seen through by Vritra. It was a one-sided slaughter, and every single person among the spectators already knew who the five hundred winners were going to be.

The Red team totally dominated the competition. Rich, who was one of the tanks, was awed by Vritra’s capability. Even though his chances of winning the whole competition were extremely slim, it was a fact that he was very talented.

The match could have been over in less than half an hour if Vritra wanted, but he continued to stretch it, and around two hours had passed when only the Red team and the tired and bruised members of the Yellow team remained.
The ones who didn’t choose any team and were too confident were the ones who were beaten the fastest—even legion-ranked warriors couldn’t fight such large groups on their own.

"Do you want us to give you some time to rest? I don’t want to defeat you all when you are at your lowest and so weak," Vritra spoke to the other team in a friendly tone, and everyone praised him again for his sportsmanship and kind nature.
Hundreds of girls seemed to be going crazy over that calm and majestic leader, who gave off such protective and warm vibes.

’Sigh... Poor lambs, no one knows he is a devil in human skin. Even the demons are afraid of him. If only you all knew him as much as I do...’Diana shook her head. She praised Vritra for his acting skill.
The people of the Yellow team were touched by his concern. They glanced at one another and decided to take Vritra up on his offer, though they knew they would most probably lose.
"Thank you, I have never met a leader as good and compassionate as you. You are a true warrior," one of the men from the other side spoke.

After they all thanked Vritra and contributed thousands of sin points, their rest began as they took their potions out and started drinking them. Vritra just stood there with his arms crossed, farming sin points and aura. Unlike Daddy V, the persona of Jin Woo was being loved by everyone, and the number of sin points was just as high.

I should have gained more than a million sin points just from a couple of hours. Heh, after a few days of this competition, my sin points will be much higher,Vritra calculated in his mind. But he didn’t glance at the number of sin points he had, to increase his excitement for the result.

After twenty minutes had passed, the Yellow team was finally ready to fight. Vritra didn’t put too much effort and deployed the same formation. Although the Yellow team was ready after seeing how the other side was fighting, Vritra’s changing commands made everything unpredictable.

It wasn’t long before more than half of the members were knocked out. Vritra slowed down the pace a bit more and allowed the other side to catch their breath. Then, after ten more minutes, the Yellow team was finally defeated.
And the Red team became the winner.

"Such a fabulous match! We have to give it all out to our wonderful leader, Jin Woo. The poise with which their group fought was just eye-opening. He commanded his group like a true commander who had very long experience. I am sure he could easily get a high position with just that brain of his," TK spoke loudly, his words full of praise.

"Now, the first day matches are over. And we have got a total of a thousand winners. All of you can return to the hall you were waiting in earlier and get your names registered. Tomorrow won’t be any matches and you can rest. The next match will start at the same time the day after tomorrow," TK announced.

Vritra and his group walked back towards the hall, while most of the losers were carried out since they were in no condition to even walk. After entering the hall, every single member thanked and began to flatter him. All of them shook hands with him while getting their names registered and getting something stamped over their badges.
After Vritra was done with his work, he walked out of the colosseum and saw the three ladies waiting for him. All of them were smiling.
"Well, this competition went much better than the one in the Dunshire Kingdom. Even the announcer didn’t disappear, hehe," Diana giggled as she remembered that chaotic competition.
"You should be hungry. Do you want to eat at the hotel or should I cook for you?" Vanessa asked as she took his right hand.
"Let’s just eat outside. The fighting wasn’t tiring at all—I barely did anything aside from commanding," Vritra said as he took Fiona’s hand and interlocked fingers with her.
"You looked so brilliant there. I never thought you could command such a large group so well. You were always alone in school," Fiona said as she hugged his arm.
The group of four walked towards the same hotel—it was already close to evening.
When they were entering, Vritra saw several men wearing white dresses from the temple and walking towards the competition venue. Just from the sight, he could sense that these people were Grieves.

chapters.title: Chapter 178: Can you remove your...
paragraphs: ’Are the Grieves going to cause trouble at the competition venue now? Sigh, even though I am trying to avoid trouble, I hope I can reach the legion rank before anything major happens.’ Vritra thought as he watched the group of men in white dresses.
But a major and life-changing event was approaching Vritra, closer to him than he could have expected.
Feeling a bit curious, he used his senses to observe the movement of their lips and made out a couple of lines before removing his senses to not get noticed.

’The Empress will fail? And something about the Bone Blood Cult... sigh, I couldn’t hear more.’ Vritra thought. He wondered how these people knew she would fail to get the inheritance, but he didn’t ponder too long about it.

They ate in the hotel before making their way back to their rooms. The climate of the Blue Kingdom seemed to be changing strangely for some reason since the morning. Sometimes a strong storm would descend, then it would start raining, then the clouds disappeared and it became hot, and just after an hour, it began to feel quite cold.

Vritra had a feeling that these changes must be because of the Scarlet Couple’s inheritance, which meant the Empress had already entered and now must be clearing up all the traps and puzzles. It wouldn’t be long before she got to the last step.
’Wifey, when do you think the hidden inheritance where the Misty Essence mythic halo is present will open?’ Vritra asked, lying over the bed and staring at the ceiling.
"The opening of the Scarlet Couple’s inheritance is a huge event. It has caused a chain reaction across the entire kingdom, as many things that had stayed hidden have suddenly become visible.

I am sure even that place will open very soon. Let’s check out the place where the map points," Yasmine suggested, and Vritra agreed. He had to get the mythic halo—it could create life-like illusions and would be great in all kinds of situations.

He sat up and looked at his mother. Vanessa had just come out of the bath, and her fragrance filled every corner of the room. Vritra stood up and wrapped his arms around her waist, pressing his lips against her neck and taking a deep breath full of her sweet smell.
"Mmm~ Honey..." Vanessa let out a soft sigh, embracing Vritra just as tightly.
"Mom, I will be going out for a bit. I need to check something and... I will be bringing Diana along with me," Vritra said, his lips moving against her cold buttery skin.

Vanessa felt a little ticklish. She hummed and replied, "Okay, but be careful while you are outside. As for that goddess, I think she is already in your palms. Just a bit more push and she would be completely devoted to you."
"Heh, yeah mom. You too be careful." Vritra said as he gave a peck on her moist pink lips before disappearing from the room.

He appeared in front of Diana’s room. After knocking, Vritra waited, and just after a few seconds the door opened. Diana too had just taken a bath and her long white hair was still a little wet, and droplets of glistening water slid down her milky skin.
She looked really beautiful. Even though her true nature was from the grace a goddess should possess, just her appearance made her stand out among countless other women.

Diana was a bit surprised that he came to meet her all of a sudden. She wondered what he wanted to talk about, while a part of her wondered if he was finally here to meet her because of the punishment he promised—cough, punishment he said he would give.

No matter how much she wanted to deny it, she seemed to have developed a strange fetish. The more disrespectful and harsh Vritra got with her, the more it excited her. She wished he would do more, but Vritra had barely paid her any attention the past few days.

’Ugh, what am I thinking? I am a goddess, how can I ever have such thoughts? There is no way I could enjoy something like that. He must have done something to me.’ Diana shook her head and tried to deny her thoughts. She wanted to get humiliated by him but at the same time hated that thought.
"Follow me." Vritra said. Diana stared at him for a second before nodding. Then she walked back into the room and came out, wearing a veil over her face and properly dressed.
"Where are we going?" the goddess asked curiously. She had no thoughts of going back to the Dunshire Kingdom ever again, so her only choice was to follow him—not to mention she had become his slave.

"Not too far. I wanted to check out something." Vritra gave a vague answer. Even though the sky had started to turn slightly dark, the market was just as lively as ever. There were many events going on in the Blue Kingdom at this time after all.
Vritra had already checked the location of the Misty Essence mythic halo. After paying a few silver coins to the coachman, the two sat in the carriage.

The streets were a lot emptier when compared to the daytime. The destination they were going to was at the far end of the city, so it took them a bit over three hours before the carriage finally stopped.

Vritra and Diana barely talked during this time. Most of his focus was on his surroundings. The reason why they didn’t just directly fly was because of all the dangerous presences around them. It was better to be late than die.

As the carriage drew away, Vritra observed his surroundings. There didn’t seem to be such dangerous presence at this part of the city. It was rather empty with no houses in sight—one side of the city was connected to another city while the other led to the forest.

"Let’s go there." Vritra gestured and led the goddess a bit deeper into the forest. Finally, he took out the map and observed his surroundings. After walking nearly a kilometre or so, Vritra finally came across a mountain.
This exactly was the location where the small inheritance which contains such a big treasure was going to open. It was impossible to know that something so godly was hidden there.
’Is there a way to hide this?’ Vritra asked. It would make everything so much easier if he were the only one who got to enter it.

"No, the opening of the inheritance will create a huge commotion, so it is just impossible to hide. Otherwise, the emperor need not send so many guards and even his protector—he would have just hidden the Scarlet Inheritance. That inheritance should have opened this morning, that is why so many changes have been occurring. Let’s hope the commotion this causes isn’t too big," Yasmine replied.
’I guess we will have to wait for it to open.’ Vritra sighed, then he glanced back at the curious goddess and began to fly in the air.
Diana saw Vritra rising high into the air, so she too followed along as the two rose above the trees and could see far away into the city.
Vritra’s lips curled up as he spoke to the baffled goddess: "Now, can you remove your clothes?"

"Hmm? Was I not clear enough? I said, can you take off all your clothes right here and now for me?" Vritra elaborated calmly.

"H-Huh? Why are you asking that? Right here? Remove all my clothes? Did you really just bring me all the way here for that?" Diana asked as her face burned with shame at just the thought of getting naked in front of him, in such an open space. How humiliating was that?

"Yeah, there is no one around here besides us, and your punishment is still due, remember?" Vritra added. He could tell that she had started to enjoy these small little games; such shameful tasks seemed to give her a strange pleasure, even if she acted like she hated it.

And Vritra wouldn’t want to force himself on her, even if she was his slave. That’s why, aside from those two times, he didn’t make any further moves. First, he wanted to corrupt this goddess—and when she finally gives in, she could finally be a part of his small family.
"A-At least let’s do that inside a room. What if someone sees me?" Diana said as she scanned the surroundings. There really was no one there.
Vritra and Yasmine had already made sure there wasn’t anyone nearby, or he wouldn’t have suggested it. Exhibitionism is a big no; just the thought of it was disgusting.

"I think doing all that here would be a lot more fun. Just imagine it. Hmm, how about you think that this is an order and you have no choice. But if you’re really against it, then let’s just go back and sleep—" Vritra sighed in disappointment and turned around.
"W-Wait..." Diana called out hurriedly. She was feeling so conflicted—she wanted to do that daring thing, but just the thought filled her with shame.
"Decide already, otherwise I’m leaving." Vritra said in a plain tone, as if he was about to leave.
"F-Fine, I will do it. Just let me cover our surroundings with a barrier. I don’t want to be seen by anyone else in that state." Diana said as her milky cheeks turned bright red.

Diana created a barrier covering a big part around them. Yasmine also created another barrier right outside it. Now, no one would even be able to sense their auras, let alone see them—they had disappeared from the real world.

Finally, she took a deep breath and began to sensually remove her clothes. She was wearing a black dress right now; as the clothes slid down her body, more of her milky skin was revealed.
Soon she was only in her panty and bra. The goddess wore rather simple and cute inner clothes. Her skin looked so smooth and creamy, as if she was made entirely from milk.
Her large boobs were barely contained inside the bra. Although her size was slightly smaller than Vanessa’s, they were still quite huge; the creamy flesh was peeking out through her bra.
Her long legs and belly—everything about her looked so savoury, making Vritra want to take a bite out of her. His eyes scanned her body from her face to her feet; she truly looked flawless.

Both the evil and good sides stood against him. It was already so dangerous for him to survive, and now even the Grieves seemed to be lingering around.

Vritra and the three women continued with their trip through the market, entering different shops and experiencing all kinds of new things. After a few hours, Vanessa and Diana returned to the hotel while Vritra and Fiona went on their date, spending quality time together.

Both of them wanted to know more about each other. The more time they spent in each other’s company, the more close they became. Vritra and Fiona sat on a bench in a park; she was hugging his arm while her head rested over his shoulder. She loved such alone moments with him.
She twirled her finger in the air and created a phoenix with flames, that spread its wings and flew away before disappearing after a few seconds.

"Your level is still too low—even Mom’s and Diana’s. All three of you need to level up too since there is too much danger around me, and sometimes you would have to depend on yourself," Vritra said, while holding her hand and tracing the lines over her soft palm with his finger.
"Mmm, I know. Should we go hunt some demons?" Fiona asked, feeling a bit tingly as Vritra squeezed and massaged her palm.

"Yeah, but let me understand this kingdom a bit more, then I will make the arrangements," Vritra answered. He didn’t want to make leveling up too easy for them—otherwise, they won’t be able to fight when danger arrives—but also not too tough.
He decided to check the areas filled with demons around. After he reaches the legion rank, he could easily help their levels rise.

The two spent several hours together, before finally returning back to the hotel. Aside from the overly excited crowd, the Blue Kingdom was quite peaceful for now. A lot of guards were stationed around the kingdom to stop anyone from disturbing the Empress.
The whole day passed in calmness, and then Vritra returned to his room. After a short routine training session, the two fell asleep under the sheet, hugging one another.

As the dawn broke, the streets became crowded as thousands of people rushed towards the competition venue. The crowd was even bigger than the last time because of the talks about Jin Woo and his team’swondrousperformance.
Diana, Vanessa, and Fiona wished him good luck before walking towards the first gate. They found empty seats soon and sat together, all three of them were wearing veils.

Vritra walked towards the other door. The line there was much shorter than the previous day, but a lot of people had gathered there to see therumoredJin Woo, who had easily obtained victory in the first round.
He was like a great hero in everyone’s eyes—the complete opposite of Daddy V.

{Sin Point Gained: Praised +1,676}

Vritra looked at the crowd and smiled faintly as he joined the line. His number had changed and now it was nine hundred ninety. The security today was just as high as the previous day; several people were asking questions and making sure there wasn’t any problem.
After all the preparations were done, Vritra found himself standing in the same hall. Though the participants there were only one thousand, so it was quite empty.
Vritra took a seat and waited for everyone to make their way into the hall. Since he was going to be in the second batch again, he could obtain the victory just like before.
After a few minutes, all the participants had arrived. Of course, because of personal reasons, very few weren’t able to reach the venue.
Soon the rude head guard, along with a few other guards, entered the hall and scanned the entire group of participants. After clicking his tongue, he began to speak in a loud voice:

"Why are you all just wasting our time for a few gold pieces when you are just going to lose in the end? Anyway, the arrangements will be just like yesterday—two groups, each of five hundred, and out of them ten from each group would be selected. Numbers up to 500 follow me, your battle will start soon."
Then he turned and walked out of the hall as nearly half of the participants followed behind him.

Vritra glanced around and didn’t see Rich there. That guy was just there for entertainment after all. Then he focused on the participants. Out of the thousand participants, only six were at the legion rank, out of which two went in the first batch.

After a few moments, he stood up and walked to the front of the large group, and everyone quieted down even before he said anything. All the participants looked at him with hope. They felt if they could join his group, they would definitely win the competition.
After ten minutes, Vritra had selected the nine members of his team, and two legion-ranked were present in it.

He could have taken all four, but that would increase the difficulty for him in the next round. He planned to eliminate those two legion-ranked young men in this round. That way, in the next round, there would only be four legion-ranked fighters.

After waiting for two hours, which Vritra used to explain his tactics to his team, the match of the first batch ended. Finally, it was their turn to go into the arena. The rude head guard led them out as they all climbed onto the stage, and the crowd went mad with cheers as they saw the red team, being led by that handsome leader.

{Sin Point Gained: Praised +38,922}
{Sin Point Gained: Liked +36,373}
Just by standing there, waves after waves of sin points flooded. Vritra looked at all the audience with a smile. His simple action made the hearts of countless girls’ flutter.

chapters.title: Chapter 185: Ominous
paragraphs: "Oh ho, our Team Red is here once again, and they have one great leader and two legion-ranked warriors! Will they be able to show us a fight as great as the previous one? Let’s not waste any time and let the fight begin." TK announced in a loud voice, his excitement matching everyone among the spectators.
As the battle began, all the other participants were quite wary of the Red Team. They too tried to copy his tactic—forming teams and using tanks and distant damage dealers.

But Vritra didn’t follow the same pattern this time. He only needed to be wary of the team which also had two legion-ranked that he had rejected earlier, after which they formed a team of their own to defeat the Red Team.
"CHARGE!!" Vritra’s thunderous voice reverberated through the entire colosseum as everyone fell silent for a moment before they burst out with loud cheers, feeling the adrenaline rush.

Without caring about the defense, nine of the members of the Red Team shot towards one of the teams, avoiding the Purple Team which had two strong warriors. The other side, which was prepared to break Red Team’s previous formation, was completely baffled.

They didn’t even have the time to put up their defenses as they got attacked. Most of the members were evenly matched, so they might have still been able to hold on, but the two legion-ranked in Red Team were the game changers.

While Vritra was responsible for the defenses of all the members, a wall of dust would rise whenever anyone from his team was about to get injured, and the opponents would suddenly slip and get knocked in the next moment.
Vritra used the dust to slowly get rid of the ten members of the other team—blinding them and making them choke. He became their worst enemy while they were getting attacked by others.

The Red Team began to destroy one team after another. This tactic seemed even more brilliant than the previous one, and it heavily depended on Vritra. The fight would have been over in less than an hour, but how could Vritra just let such a great opportunity go to waste?
He collected as many sin points as possible. The number of spectators was much higher today, so Vritra slowed the pace and took a few rests in the middle of the match.

Still, after a little over four hours, only two teams remained on the stage. One was Red and the other was Purple. The two legion-ranked warriors were the biggest concern, but it was still within Vritra’s expectations.
As the final part of the fight began, the legion-ranked of Red and Purple Team began to fight one another, while the remaining matched against one another.

Vritra decided to reveal a bit of his strength; otherwise, if he suddenly defeated a legion-ranked the next day, then it would seem too suspicious. Forming two claws of dust, Vritra’s body became a blur as he knocked out the members of the other team with single and precise hits.
The other team didn’t even have the time to react as Vritra flashed behind them and hit the backs of their heads accurately, causing them to pass out instantly.
Everyone was amazed by Vritra’s prowess and efficiency. He had played the biggest part in the fight even today—his performance was even better than the legion-ranked.

From the spectators, Rich observed the fight in awe, seeing Vritra as a great commander that could easily lead armies of hundreds of thousands of people and bring easy victories with his strange tactics.
After dealing with the eight members within moments, he helped his team defeat the final two members, and after around twenty or so minutes, the fight finally ended.

"Whoa, excellent!! Bravo!! The Red Team—or rather Jin Woo—surely didn’t disappoint us. He surely is quite skilled in leading his team. And as everyone can see, we have our ten winners right here." TK said, his voice thundering.

After letting the crowd scream out a bit, he continued: "There will be one day of rest for our great warriors, and the day after tomorrow will be the finale where a single winner will be selected. And I have a special news for you all..."
He paused to create suspense among everyone. After a few seconds, he spoke: "On the finale, the King of the Blue Kingdom himself will come to give a special reward to the winner!!"
The crowd cheered even louder. From their shouts, it seemed they all loved their king quite a bit and were excited to see him.

Vritra didn’t care much about the king, but he had to know a bit about him to avoid any kind of future problem. Any kind of new change occurs around him and he gets the feeling that a new trouble is coming.

After collecting some more sin points, Vritra made his way back into the hall. After the registering process and shaking hands with all the flattering young men, he walked out of the colosseum and soon found the three women waiting for him.
"Honey, today’s battle was just as fantastic. You did so great even after hiding almost all of your strength," Vanessa said as she gave him a tight hug.
"You shone brilliantly in the arena, I love you!!" Fiona didn’t hesitate or shy away as she embraced Vritra too, giving a kiss over his cheek.
"Uhm... It’s good that you spared all those lambs—I mean, all those men." Diana said with a smile.
"Let’s go and eat something. And Diana, what do you know about the king?" Vritra asked as they began to walk away and soon arrived at the hotel.

"About the king... his name is Henry, and he is at the peak of 1st Legion rank and close to reaching the 2nd. He is a much better ruler than Aldric, who always put on an act and put himself above all others.
Well, from what I know, he does treat this kingdom as his own home and these people as his family. That’s why the Blue Kingdom is prospering so quickly.
Aside from that... hmm, oh yeah, I heard he has many wives and concubines and more than twenty children. His age should be a hundred."
Diana spoke whatever knowledge she possessed about the king of the Blue Kingdom. Of course, she had only met him a few times, so couldn’t be too sure about his nature.
’He doesn’t seem like a bad ruler. Wifey, do you know anything about him?’ Vritra asked. He wanted to make sure that this change—the arrival of the king—wasn’t a new ominous sign for him.

"I have never met him personally, but I did hear that he is a good ruler, and after a few more centuries, under his ruling this kingdom might even match the White Kingdom of this continent." Yasmine replied. She wouldn’t know too much about such a small kingdom where even the top powers are so weak.
’Looks pretty safe. I guess I was getting worried for nothing.’ Vritra sighed and set the matter aside for now.
After taking their seats in the hotel, they gave their order and soon began to eat together while talking about all sorts of things. This was such a wholesome time.
