chapters.title: Chapter 186: A Bad Feeling
paragraphs: After eating food at the hotel, the group of four strolled in the market for a while before returning to their rooms. Even though their current routine seemed a bit repetitive, they all enjoyed it as this time was very relaxing with no direct threats or dangers.

The next day was going to be free, and Vritra planned to spend half his time with his mother and the other half with Fiona. He wanted Diana to starve more until even her shame couldn’t stop her from asking for it.

Vritra and Vanessa took baths after returning to their room and then lay on the bed, talking about various things. He didn’t know why, but Vritra seemed to have a premonition that the arrival of the king might lead to some kind of conflict—his luck was just so bad.

Burying his face into her warm and soft boobs, Vritra hugged her body tightly. The two lay completely naked under the sheet, and they were completely comfortable with this level of intimacy. They no longer cared if it was a taboo or not.

Vritra rubbed his lips against her smooth skin and began to speak in a low voice: "You know mom, when I fell in that trap inside the labyrinth. It was Max’s group and those guards that forced me to jump inside—"

"What?!! Those assholes, I am going to kill—hmm, but I think they are all dead? Sigh, why didn’t you tell me about it sooner, I would have torn them apart with my own hands." Vanessa bubbled in rage, imagining thousands of ways she would have tortured and killed those sons of bitches.

"Haha, yeah, almost all of them are dead. Only one is alive and well... he should be having the time of his life with some old guy, but he will be dead soon. Anyway, all of them have been taken care of. After falling into that trap, I fought a lot of demons, that’s why my level rose so quickly in such a short time." Vritra explained all this to his mother.

He even told her a bit about his mythic halo but without going into too much detail. After all, too much knowledge can sometimes attract trouble—he wasn’t sure exactly how, but Yasmine advised him so.

They talked for a bit longer before falling asleep. Vanessa was extremely happy that they were getting closer. She hugged him tightly as Vritra latched onto her nipple and drank her sweet, hot milk like a baby as he fell asleep.

The next day passed quite wonderfully. Vritra first went out with Fiona and toured the city, as the two shared different things about themselves with one another. This type of interaction made them love each other even more.
Fiona also loved that Vritra was sharing various moments of his life that she had no idea about. She was getting to know him more and fell even deeper for him, loving every part of him.

Of course, Vritra also got to know many things about Fiona, like her life and interests back on Earth—how she loved music and daily went to her cousin to learn instruments, many things that happened after they had arrived in the Dunshire Kingdom.
And so on...
The two spent over half the day together. Vritra wanted to make their relationship as close as between him and Yasmine or between him and Vanessa before they took the next step of their relationship.

After returning from his date, Vritra didn’t pay much attention to Diana, even though it seemed she had something to say—something that she desperately needed—but the goddess couldn’t bring herself to directly speak her desires. Her face burned with shame whenever she gathered the courage to do so.

After parting from Fiona, Vritra went to his mother. The two of them went out as well. He knew that she completely supported his relationship with Fiona and even with Diana, but he didn’t plan to decrease their time together because of his other relationships.
He left Bobby behind to protect the two women as he went out with his mother. The pair of mother and son had a great time outside, and they didn’t return until it was late in the night.

Since the next day was going to be the finale of the competition, Vritra and Vanessa kept their training session short—after making a new experience in a beautiful place Vritra booked just for the two of them.
After returning, they fell asleep, their breaths and dreams entangling with one another.
The next day came quite quickly. The good times always pass fast after all.
After dressing up and eating breakfast, Vritra and the three women walked towards the colosseum.
"Honey, will you be fine?" Vanessa asked. Today, he was going to fight against at least one legion-ranked warrior—or maybe even more—so she was naturally worried.

"Of course, I will be fine. At most I will lose, then we can just look for that stone elsewhere. It’s nothing serious." Vritra said with a calm expression, though a bad feeling was rising in his heart. It wasn’t related to his match, but something else entirely.
Still, his calm appearance made the three beautiful ladies feel relaxed. Their faces were covered with veils, but they were still catching so many gazes from all around.

It didn’t take long before they arrived at the colosseum, where the crowd seemed even higher than the previous matches. There should be up to fifty thousand spectators, and the entire place was flooded with people—only a few seats remained.
"Just be safe, honey. It is fine even if you lose the map, and you can’t reveal that to anyone." Vanessa said before whispering the last part into his ear.
"I will jump to help you out and blast all your opponents, so don’t worry and beat the shit out of them all." Fiona said, making pew pew pew gestures in the air.
"Haha, sure, but make sure you don’t toast them up. We can’t kill anyone, remember?" Vritra laughed and lightly pinched her soft cheek.
"I know you will win." Diana said, a dazzling smile appearing on her face under the veil.
"Alright, I will be going now." Vritra said and watched the three ladies enter the colosseum. After they had found their seats, he walked away from there.
’Just what could go wrong at a time like this... or did I become too paranoid? Sigh...’ Vritra sighed and arrived at the entrance. There was no line today since there were only twenty participants.

"I completely believe in your bad luck. Trouble is always building around you. And somehow, you are always at its centre. Haa, hubby, now you are making even me feel anxious." Yasmine said, shaking her head.

After a round of questions and checking, Vritra made his way into the hall. He saw the other nineteen men were standing in a horizontal line in front of a man in his thirties who wore expensive and flashy clothes.
"Oh, our great commander Jin Woo is here." The flashy man spoke, his voice full of arrogance as if he owned the world.
’Is this it?’ Vritra wondered as he walked towards the group and looked at the other participants questioningly.
"Jin Woo, what are you doing? He is the prince—pay your respect." One of the young men said.

sentences.text: After eating food at the hotel, the group of four strolled in the market for a while before returning to their rooms.
Even though their current routine seemed a bit repetitive, they all enjoyed it as this time was very relaxing with no direct threats or dangers.
The next day was going to be free, and Vritra planned to spend half his time with his mother and the other half with Fiona.
He wanted Diana to starve more until even her shame couldn’t stop her from asking for it.
Vritra and Vanessa took baths after returning to their room and then lay on the bed, talking about various things.
He didn’t know why, but Vritra seemed to have a premonition that the arrival of the king might lead to some kind of conflict—his luck was just so bad.
Burying his face into her warm and soft boobs, Vritra hugged her body tightly.
The two lay completely naked under the sheet, and they were completely comfortable with this level of intimacy.
They no longer cared if it was a taboo or not.
Vritra rubbed his lips against her smooth skin and began to speak in a low voice: "You know mom, when I fell in that trap inside the labyrinth.
It was Max’s group and those guards that forced me to jump inside—"
"What?!!
Those assholes, I am going to kill—hmm, but I think they are all dead?

Sigh, why didn’t you tell me about it sooner, I would have torn them apart with my own hands." Vanessa bubbled in rage, imagining thousands of ways she would have tortured and killed those sons of bitches.
"Haha, yeah, almost all of them are dead.
Only one is alive and well... he should be having the time of his life with some old guy, but he will be dead soon.
Anyway, all of them have been taken care of.
After falling into that trap, I fought a lot of demons, that’s why my level rose so quickly in such a short time." Vritra explained all this to his mother.
He even told her a bit about his mythic halo but without going into too much detail.
After all, too much knowledge can sometimes attract trouble—he wasn’t sure exactly how, but Yasmine advised him so.
They talked for a bit longer before falling asleep.
Vanessa was extremely happy that they were getting closer.
She hugged him tightly as Vritra latched onto her nipple and drank her sweet, hot milk like a baby as he fell asleep.
The next day passed quite wonderfully.
Vritra first went out with Fiona and toured the city, as the two shared different things about themselves with one another.
This type of interaction made them love each other even more.
Fiona also loved that Vritra was sharing various moments of his life that she had no idea about.
She was getting to know him more and fell even deeper for him, loving every part of him.

Of course, Vritra also got to know many things about Fiona, like her life and interests back on Earth—how she loved music and daily went to her cousin to learn instruments, many things that happened after they had arrived in the Dunshire Kingdom.
And so on...
The two spent over half the day together.
Vritra wanted to make their relationship as close as between him and Yasmine or between him and Vanessa before they took the next step of their relationship.

After returning from his date, Vritra didn’t pay much attention to Diana, even though it seemed she had something to say—something that she desperately needed—but the goddess couldn’t bring herself to directly speak her desires.
Her face burned with shame whenever she gathered the courage to do so.
After parting from Fiona, Vritra went to his mother.
The two of them went out as well.
He knew that she completely supported his relationship with Fiona and even with Diana, but he didn’t plan to decrease their time together because of his other relationships.
He left Bobby behind to protect the two women as he went out with his mother.
The pair of mother and son had a great time outside, and they didn’t return until it was late in the night.

Since the next day was going to be the finale of the competition, Vritra and Vanessa kept their training session short—after making a new experience in a beautiful place Vritra booked just for the two of them.
After returning, they fell asleep, their breaths and dreams entangling with one another.
The next day came quite quickly.
The good times always pass fast after all.
After dressing up and eating breakfast, Vritra and the three women walked towards the colosseum.
"Honey, will you be fine?" Vanessa asked.
Today, he was going to fight against at least one legion-ranked warrior—or maybe even more—so she was naturally worried.
"Of course, I will be fine.
At most I will lose, then we can just look for that stone elsewhere.
It’s nothing serious." Vritra said with a calm expression, though a bad feeling was rising in his heart.
It wasn’t related to his match, but something else entirely.
Still, his calm appearance made the three beautiful ladies feel relaxed.
Their faces were covered with veils, but they were still catching so many gazes from all around.
It didn’t take long before they arrived at the colosseum, where the crowd seemed even higher than the previous matches.
There should be up to fifty thousand spectators, and the entire place was flooded with people—only a few seats remained.
"Just be safe, honey.
It is fine even if you lose the map, and you can’t reveal that to anyone." Vanessa said before whispering the last part into his ear.
"I will jump to help you out and blast all your opponents, so don’t worry and beat the shit out of them all." Fiona said, making pew pew pew gestures in the air.
"Haha, sure, but make sure you don’t toast them up.
We can’t kill anyone, remember?" Vritra laughed and lightly pinched her soft cheek.
"I know you will win." Diana said, a dazzling smile appearing on her face under the veil.
"Alright, I will be going now." Vritra said and watched the three ladies enter the colosseum.
After they had found their seats, he walked away from there.
’Just what could go wrong at a time like this... or did I become too paranoid?
Sigh...’ Vritra sighed and arrived at the entrance.
There was no line today since there were only twenty participants.
"I completely believe in your bad luck.
Trouble is always building around you.
And somehow, you are always at its centre.
Haa, hubby, now you are making even me feel anxious." Yasmine said, shaking her head.
After a round of questions and checking, Vritra made his way into the hall.
He saw the other nineteen men were standing in a horizontal line in front of a man in his thirties who wore expensive and flashy clothes.
"Oh, our great commander Jin Woo is here." The flashy man spoke, his voice full of arrogance as if he owned the world.
’Is this it?’ Vritra wondered as he walked towards the group and looked at the other participants questioningly.
"Jin Woo, what are you doing?
He is the prince—pay your respect." One of the young men said.

chapters.title: Chapter 187: Lucky
paragraphs: "Jin Woo, what are you doing? He is the prince—pay your respect," one of the young men said.
Vritra stood at one end of the line and bowed slightly in front of the prince before speaking, "It’s a pleasure to meet you, prince."

The prince stared at Vritra for a few seconds, then he nodded and, with a chuckle, he spoke, "I had heard a lot about you. Your fights have gained a lot of popularity. Though it would be impossible to defeat those legion-ranked warriors with your current strength, what do you think about joining me as my advisor?"

’Ah, so he is here only to make me join his side? Is that really all?’ Vritra wondered. After showing a surprised expression on his face, Vritra spoke, "Thank you very much, prince. If I really lose, then I would love to join you on your great journey."
 .

"Haha! You are indeed quite smart. Good, I will send you the invitation after the competition ends. I am really impressed by your performance," the prince said with a smile. After saying a few encouraging words, he turned and walked away along with his guards.
{Sin Point Gained: Envied +19}

All the others looked at Vritra in envy. One of them sighed and spoke in exasperation, "Jin Woo, I can’t believe the crown prince himself came here to meet you. You are really too talented and lucky."

They talked for a while before the rude head guard came once again into the hall. He glanced at the twenty participants and wrinkled his nose, but since the prince’s guards seemed to be lingering there, he held back on his nasty comments.
"Follow me out, all of you. Today’s match will be different. Each of you will be paired against anyone among you all, and you would have to defeat your opponent to reach the next level."

By the time the explanation ended, they had arrived outside, and the loud cheering of the crowd shook the entire colosseum. The place was too crowded, and some special arrangements seemed to have been made today for the arrival of the king.
Like setting up a high stage with a throne beside the arena, the number of guards was even higher, and the whole place was decorated even more nicely.
"It’s TK here, and we are here to witness the fight between the top talents of the Blue Kingdom!!" TK jumped onto the arena and shouted with all his might.

"Today, for the first part of the competition, the stage will be divided into ten parts, and the fighters who defeat their opponents will move to the next round," TK announced as, in the next moment, barriers formed over the large arena.
"Let’s welcome our fighters!!" TK said as Vritra and the others walked into the open. The spectators roared wildly, waiting for some great battles.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +48,356}
{Sin Point Gained: Expected +42,524}
{Sin Point Gained: Pitied +26,704}

The moment Vritra stepped onto the arena, sin points poured out wildly, their speed faster than ever. Looking around at the spectators with a smile, Vritra located Vanessa, Fiona, and Diana easily. The three women were cheering for him as well.

"Now, all the participants, please enter the barrier where your number is indicated. May strength and luck be with you. And Jin Woo, I have high hopes for you, but it’s a pity that you are yet to reach the Legion rank, sigh..." TK spoke, mirroring the emotions of many in the crowd.
Vritra saw his number twenty and walked into the barrier. There were four legion-ranked warriors in total—he hoped not to face one right off the start.
After a wait of a few seconds, a man at level 815 walked into his barrier hesitantly. It was one of the people Vritra had knowingly chosen to decrease the competition in the last round.
While the boy was hesitant because he had passed both rounds due to Vritra, he didn’t want to repay his help and kindness by being rude—not to mention, Vritra’s level was much higher than his own.

"I admit defeat. I can’t attack someone as noble and kind as Jin Woo, who helped me so much previously." After speaking, the young man walked out of the barrier, heaving a sigh of relief. He avoided the defeat and even gained public sympathy.
"And we have got our first winner just like that!" TK announced before focusing on another match.
Two more people admitted defeat who were put against two of the legion-ranked fighters, while the remaining legion fighters ended up facing one another.
Vritra just stood calmly as he observed the fights of those four fighters. It wasn’t long before the fight was over, and now among the ten fighters, only three legion-ranked fighters remained.
"Now, it is time for our round two! This time, there will be five partitions. Make sure to stand till the end!" TK said before jumping out of the arena as the barriers disappeared and reformed.
Now the arena was divided into five parts, and two names were written over each part. The participants made their way into the barriers.
Vritra sighed in relief, as again he was about to face a rather weaker participant among the top ten. But unfortunately, this time, the legion-ranked fighters didn’t end up against one another.
Just as the match started, four of the young men admitted defeat immediately. Vritra’s opponent made the same excuse, and the other three couldn’t fight against the legion-ranked warriors.
"Hmm... These rounds are rather peaceful. Even our crowd has become so silent; there are barely any fights. Anyway, we have our five top fighters!!" TK clapped and then continued:

"Out of these five, one of them will be able to move to the next part without fighting. And that name will be selected by our dear spectators! So, who do you believe should be sent directly to the next round?"
"JIN WOO!! JIN WOO!!" Everyone was shouting this name—after all, his popularity was much higher than all the others.

Vritra felt happy that instead of Daddy V, he used Jin Woo. Otherwise, these people would have never voted for Daddy V. Instead, they would have forced him to fight the legion warriors right from the start.

"Alright, so it has been decided! Jin Woo will head to the final round directly! Yes, you haven’t heard it wrong—this is the decision right from above! Don’t we all want to see the greatest mind against the oppressing force? Who do you believe will win?!" TK said, making the crowd excited once again.
He wiped the sweat off his forehead. This job wasn’t easy—he had to always keep the audience excited and also make the higher-ups happy.
Soon, the next round began. Vritra stood calmly at one corner of the arena. One warrior directly admitted defeat since he didn’t want to face a legion rank.
While the two other legion-ranked were facing one another, after a long and hard fight, one was knocked out.
After a short break, the semi-final began, and the two remaining legion-ranked fought against one another until one of them came out victorious.
"And number 4 has become the winner of this round! Now number 4 will be facing off against Jin Woo—the fight we all awaited!" TK said.

chapters.title: Chapter 188: The Finale
paragraphs: "Number four will be fighting against Jin Woo, but before that!!" TK paused suddenly, creating suspense amongst the crowd, then in a loud voice he announced:
"Our king, Lord Henry, has arrived to witness the final battle between the prodigies. Let’s welcome our lord."
The crowd screamed wildly, calling out to the king and showing their respect and love for him. How could the king make a simple entry when the people were so excited?
A very strong gust of wind swept through the entire colosseum, surprising the people. The clothes of all the people fluttered, and everyone shut their eyes for a moment.

Diana, being experienced in wearing veils, reacted fast as she covered her face and stopped the veil from flying away in time, but Vanessa and Fiona weren’t as fast—they were too surprised by the sudden wind to care about the veil.
But they quickly took out new veils and covered their faces.
Finally, from the sky, the king descended along with four guards standing and hovering behind him. He truly possessed a mighty aura that would make Aldric appear a joke.
From his appearance, he seemed to be in his thirties. His body was well-trained and had some nice muscles; all in all, he looked good.

The king and his guards landed on the high platform. He swept his gaze through the crowd with a huge smile on his face. After letting the crowd scream for a few seconds, he raised his hands to quieten everyone.

"I am very pleased that you are enjoying this event. It’s been many years since a competition of this level happened in our kingdom. And as your king, the head of the entire big family, I am—" Henry suddenly paused as his eyes got fixed on someone in the crowd.

The king seemed in a trance. He stared dazedly at the crowd with his mouth still open, the words he was about to speak frozen. After a moment, his eyes widened in surprise. He took a step forward but then came out of his stupor and composed himself.
Vritra followed the king’s gaze and frowned upon seeing that the king was looking at Vanessa out of all the people in the crowd. It didn’t seem to be some sort of coincidence.
And Vritra finally understood why he had been feeling that way since earlier. Narrowing his eyes, he began to observe the king and his guards carefully.

’Ah shit, are the false rumors going to become a reality now? Looks like the king might have to retire a bit early. I guess I’ll help the crown prince out a bit,’ he thought, without making any movements just yet.
Vanessa felt the king’s gaze and felt uncomfortable, but she just sat calmly, wondering why he kept staring at her.
Coughing lightly, Henry acted as if nothing was wrong. After glancing at the gorgeous veiled woman one more time, he addressed the crowd.
"Oh no, we overlooked one major problem." Just then, Yasmine’s hurried voice rang out in Vritra’s head.
’What is it? Is this related to Henry’s attention towards mom?’ Vritra asked, hoping that it doesn’t develop into something big.

"I have told you before, succubus are even rarer than dragons. They are always in danger since all the people of different races want to get their hands on them. And mother-in-law doesn’t have a way to hide her... hmm, aura.

Anyway, I have a feeling that the king might have somehow noticed that she is a succubus, but I don’t think he knows that she is the succubus queen. Otherwise, he would have made a move already. But the situation is already bad," Yasmine said.

’Tch, I think it might be because of that as well. I hope he doesn’t make any move just yet or I will tear him to pieces right here and now.’ Vritra barely managed to stop the demonic energy from flooding out of his body.
Thankfully, the king acted as if nothing was wrong. He continued with his speech for a while before announcing the start of the final battle.

’I will have to get rid of him somehow. I can tell he is definitely planning to do something. And more importantly, how do I hide this fact from everyone—that she is a succubus?’ Vritra sighed in his mind. Right now, the threat is still not too big, but in the future even stronger people might notice it, and then it could get really dangerous.
"Dear participants, your battle starts now!!"
Just while Vritra was deep in thought, TK announced as he moved out of the arena. The crowd began to cheer for the most anticipated fight.
All of them hoped for Jin Woo to win, even if there was really no chance of it happening—and this contributed hundreds of thousands of points to him.
"Are you ready?" the other man, who possessed the ice ability, spoke as he formed a long sword over his hands, waiting for Vritra to get ready.
[Shift Activated.]
[Strength → Agility]
Strength: 800Agility: 17,008

"Yes, let’s start." Vritra spoke calmly. Using the Shift skill, he could make one of his attributes match the other party or even slightly surpass him. As his level becomes higher, the Shift skill becomes even more terrifying.

’I wonder how fast I will be now...’ Vritra thought. Dust swirled in the air and completely covered the entire barrier, making it difficult for others to see—but many outside could still sense them perfectly.

"Here I come," the ice boy said before he rushed forward at full speed. The moment his feet touched the floor, the entire floor was covered by a layer of ice. This was to make it difficult for Vritra to move—of course, until he possessed the ability to fly.
WHOOSH

Ice guy was completely confident in his victory. But since Vritra was such a good guy, he had decided to give him an easy defeat without any pain or humiliation. He just needed to put the ice sword at Vritra’s throat.
But contrary to his expectations, Vritra could clearly trace his movements with his eyes, and it became evident that the ice guy was a bit slower.

’Haa, just some time ago I was completely helpless against a legion-ranked creature with similar strength—and now I can even hold back when fighting someone of that level,’ Vritra thought. If he wanted, he could have just used Forbidden and other skills to beat him, but his victory needed to seem barely achieved and because of luck.

Shifting his body ever so slightly, Vritra formed a dust rope and just as he dodged the two swords from the shocked guy, the rope wrapped around the knees of the other guy like a snake, almost making him trip over.

Then, continuing with his attack, Vritra used Shift again and launched a heavy roundhouse kick at the ice guy’s shoulder. A cracking sound rang out—his right hand wasn’t broken but only got dislocated.
Since Vritra didn’t use his full strength.
[Shift Activated.]
[Agility → Strength]
Agility: 1,000Strength: 16,808
The ice guy was truly baffled by this. He was so sure of his victory in just one move that he wasn’t able to react in time. As a result, his right hand hung by his shoulder—completely limp.

[Strength → Agility]
Strength: 800Agility: 17,008
"Yes, let’s start." Vritra spoke calmly.
Using the Shift skill, he could make one of his attributes match the other party or even slightly surpass him.
As his level becomes higher, the Shift skill becomes even more terrifying.
’I wonder how fast I will be now...’ Vritra thought.
Dust swirled in the air and completely covered the entire barrier, making it difficult for others to see—but many outside could still sense them perfectly.
"Here I come," the ice boy said before he rushed forward at full speed.
The moment his feet touched the floor, the entire floor was covered by a layer of ice.
This was to make it difficult for Vritra to move—of course, until he possessed the ability to fly.
WHOOSH
Ice guy was completely confident in his victory.
But since Vritra was such a good guy, he had decided to give him an easy defeat without any pain or humiliation.
He just needed to put the ice sword at Vritra’s throat.
But contrary to his expectations, Vritra could clearly trace his movements with his eyes, and it became evident that the ice guy was a bit slower.
’Haa, just some time ago I was completely helpless against a legion-ranked creature with similar strength—and now I can even hold back when fighting someone of that level,’ Vritra thought.
If he wanted, he could have just used Forbidden and other skills to beat him, but his victory needed to seem barely achieved and because of luck.

Shifting his body ever so slightly, Vritra formed a dust rope and just as he dodged the two swords from the shocked guy, the rope wrapped around the knees of the other guy like a snake, almost making him trip over.
Then, continuing with his attack, Vritra used Shift again and launched a heavy roundhouse kick at the ice guy’s shoulder.
A cracking sound rang out—his right hand wasn’t broken but only got dislocated.
Since Vritra didn’t use his full strength.
[Shift Activated.]
[Agility → Strength]
Agility: 1,000Strength: 16,808
The ice guy was truly baffled by this.
He was so sure of his victory in just one move that he wasn’t able to react in time.
As a result, his right hand hung by his shoulder—completely limp.

chapters.title: Chapter 189: Rewards
paragraphs: Vritra could have continued with his attack, but he enjoyed the rain of sin points. After this, he would definitely be able to upgrade a skill or two. Even while fighting this legion rank, Vritra had the time to think about which skill to upgrade and how to get rid of the king.

"Oh! You are stronger than I thought. I am sorry for looking down on you. I guess this is the price of my mistake. Anyway, I won’t make the same mistake again. I will be going all out from now on," the ice guy spoke, his expression becoming solemn.
"Sure, though I will still look down on you—cough, I mean, let’s have a good fight." Daddy V almost came out, but Vritra held him back, continuing with Jin Woo.

The two remained silent for a few seconds before rushing forward. Number four’s body was soon completely covered by ice, but he didn’t notice the tiny cut that appeared over his shoulder. A drop of blood stuck to Vritra’s shoe.
With a fluid motion, he touched the drop of blood before barely managing to dodge the several ice spikes that rushed from different directions.
[Blood Lock Activated.]

Now, Vritra just needed to wait a bit until the ice guy got a bit weaker. Until then, he only needed to pretend to barely dodge and get a few cuts over his skin. He used Shift and sent most of his strength points into agility.

The ice guy was using all kinds of skills—he tried to trap Vritra, corner him, and whatnot, but Vritra was always one step ahead. Even though he got a few cuts here and there, he was barely managing to hold on. All the audience had gone quiet and were on the edge of their seats, feeling very anxious.

At several moments, it seemed Vritra was about to lose or get severely injured, but he always got out with small injuries. But in reality, Vritra didn’t receive any cut—otherwise, his purple blood would have been visible. It was all fake, as his clothes got covered in red blood taken from the corpses stored in his inventory.

The fight continued for over an hour, and the ice guy had started to notice that his body seemed slower and his overall battle prowess had also decreased—after all, the difference was over thirty percent.

So far, Vritra had just been dodging, but now he finally started to counterattack, though they were barely doing anything. The spectators were extremely nervous, especially the ones that supported Vritra.

The notifications of sin points were almost blinding—they kept refreshing every passing moment. Vritra glanced towards the king and saw him glancing towards Vanessa several times. He was already making plans to abduct her.

There is almost no chance that a person in a high position wouldn’t be corrupted, no matter how good they appeared to everyone. It’s just that a few people have their principles, and others wouldn’t hesitate to make the most cruel choices for their benefits.

’If I kill him directly, it will undoubtedly attract a lot of trouble... hmm, I guess I might have to use the first prince for it, but how do I do that?’ Vritra pondered as he hit the ice guy’s face with a dust whip and barely dodged another attack.
The three women’s entire attention was completely on Vritra. They were still worried about him. Though they could tell he wasn’t really injured—Vritra had informed a bit of his plan to them.
Fiona and Diana were quite surprised that Vritra could actually match that level of strength so easily. How long had it been since he arrived in this world, after all?

After thirty or so more minutes, the ice guy had greatly weakened, and finally, the match seemed as if it was about to come to an end. Vritra seemed to be barely standing, but it looked as if he was holding on purely by willpower.
BANG

With an explosive sound, the ice guy fell back and began to pant heavily. He stared at the sky in amazement. Never would he have thought that he would actually end up losing—though Vritra seemed in a much worse shape than him—but in the end, he was the loser.
"AMAZING!!None of us could have imagined such a result—Jin Woo has become the champion of the competition!!" TK roared along with the audience. All the people were truly shocked.
Vritra, at level 999, had managed to defeat a legion-ranked warrior. This was such a great feat that it had happened only a very, very few times in history.

"So you are the Jin Woo that I have been hearing a lot about these past few days. Go give him healing medicine," the king ordered one of his guards, who disappeared and appeared beside Vritra, who was seated on the floor and breathing heavily.

Taking the potion, Vritra thanked the king and drank it immediately. No kind of poison was effective against him after he obtained the twin hearts. Not to mention, the king wouldn’t just try to kill him for no reason.
"Thank you, my lord." After a short rest, Vritra stood up and bowed slightly. Then he stood straight and glanced at the ice guy, giving him a short nod.
Soon the ice guy was carried out by a few guards as the barrier disappeared. TK climbed onto the arena and patted Vritra’s shoulder before speaking in a thunderous voice:
"Give a cheer for our winner, Jin Woooooo!!"
The public screamed wildly and sent even more sin points. Then the king flew from his throne, followed by his guards, as he landed in front of Vritra and stood proudly.
As the public quieted down, Vritra bowed slightly again and said respectfully: "I am sorry, my lord. I don’t know the right way to greet someone of your position."

"Haha, it is perfectly fine. Young and promising men like you should just focus on their future. Your battle just now was truly brilliant. If you wish, I can give you a spot of high position right now," Henry spoke. He caressed his long moustache and touched the hilt of the sword present at his waist.
"Thank you for your offer, but for now I wish to wander around the world. But I would certainly love to help the people of our kingdom after I am done," Vritra declined politely.
"It is fine, I understand." The king nodded, then he looked towards the sky and said in a rather humble way: "Sir, he is the winner from our kingdom."
Vritra too looked above, but he couldn’t sense anyone there. Maybe Nether Eye could help, but for now, he couldn’t use it.
Just then, a man wrapped in black clothes, almost like a ninja, descended from the sky and landed slowly beside the king and Vritra.
Without saying a word, he took out a black cube and passed it to Vritra before asking: "What is your field?"
His voice was rough and seemed to have an oppressive aura much stronger than even Henry.
"I don’t know, sir," Vritra replied, as he glanced at the Glyph before putting it away. This was the first one he came in contact with, after all.
"So, an empty 1st-grade Legion stone..." he mumbled and took out another object.

chapters.title: Chapter 190: In the Darkness...
paragraphs: The ninja-like man took out a gem-like, colorless stone and directly handed it to Vritra. After handing the promised reward, he said:
"Keep the emblem safe. When it is time, we will find you."

After saying those few words in his rough voice, the ninja man disappeared. All the people were silent at this moment; even the king stood with utter respect toward that unknown ninja. After he disappeared, Henry laughed and spoke in a joyous tone:
"This kingdom is really lucky to have someone like you. I will help you grow as much as I can, so do your best and win in whatever lies ahead. I feel you are going to make it very big."
After speaking, Henry gestured toward his guard and added:
"This is a small gift from me. I hope you will like it, and that it will help you a little in your journey forward."
As he spoke, one of his guards stepped forward and then took out a glyph from a storage glyph, then handed it to Vritra.

"This will create a protective barrier that could even take up to three attacks from 2nd Legion-ranked fighters. It can be spread up to a range of twenty meters. It will protect you until you have surpassed that stage," Henry spoke in a jovial tone.
"Thank you, Your Majesty," Vritra said as he placed the stone and the cube in his inventory. Just in a single day, he had obtained two glyphs—one a storage, and the other a defensive type.
"Although my understanding of the glyphs is not too high, it is still better than most in these small kingdoms. This kind and noble king believes he is too sly.

Heh, hubby, he has set up a way through which he will always be able to track your location even if you are far away. Looks like he plans to either make you his underling or else just eliminate you," Yasmine said after briefly observing the defensive glyph.

’I see, he is way too opportunistic and ambitious. He must be planning to control me somehow—either by appearing good and kind or, if that fails, then use force.’ Vritra could easily understand Henry’s thoughts. But if that was all, then the poor king wouldn’t have needed to die.

"Good, good. Take this ring. It will grant you the permission to enter the castle at any time, and you can directly meet me whenever you want," the king spoke as he handed Vritra a ring with a diamond on it, and the name of the king was written on the diamond.
"Oh! Thank you very much, my lord!!" Vritra said in an excited tone.
After saying a bit more gibberish to portray himself as a good, kind man, the king flew into the air and waved at the spectators. His gaze briefly passed over Vanessa.

He whispered something to one of his guards, who nodded and disappeared from sight, flying away at full speed. Then the king and his remaining guards also flew away, while everyone in the public was praising Vritra—and many even felt envious.

After lingering for a bit longer on the stage, Vritra turned around and walked to the hall. He met many people there, all of whom congratulated him, and even the rude head guard acted nicely toward him.
After all, Vritra was the top talent of the Blue Kingdom—everyone wanted to have a good relationship with him.

After a few minutes, Vritra made his way toward the other door and waited for his mother, Fiona, and Diana to come out. Since there were too many people today, they were walking out slowly and systematically to avoid any accidents.

"Honey!!" Vanessa called out as soon as she saw Vritra. She jumped into his arms, not caring about all the blood on his clothes. Then Fiona did the same. Diana seemed as if she wanted to hug Vritra too, but she couldn’t do it without his permission.
"Are you really okay?" Vanessa and Fiona asked at the same time. Even though his clothes were completely dyed with blood, it didn’t look like he was injured at all.
"Yeah, I am fine. Let’s go from here—we need to talk about something important," Vritra said, as he sensed two pairs of eyes staring at them from the shadows.

As he expected, the king had already sent his men to keep an eye on Vanessa. Maybe because her level was still too low, he wasn’t completely sure about his discovery and needed to spy on her to confirm it.

’It isn’t the guard that the king sent, but these two spies are both at the early levels of the Legion rank.’ Vritra thought, and Yasmine informed him of the same. Pretending as if he hadn’t noticed anything, they began following their daily routine.

The group of four walked to the hotel and began eating. But even after eating, they stayed there. Vritra whispered something to the three women, then he leaned back, sat relaxedly, and closed his eyes as if he was about to take a short nap after that long, hard battle.

The two men continued to stare at them from the outside. These two were the king’s hidden troops, who were responsible for gathering information. Even though this mission was so easy, both of them were still doing their best.
They kept looking at the group carefully. Diana, Vanessa, and Fiona began to chat among themselves and no longer disturbed Vritra, who seemed to have fallen asleep. His breathing became even.
"Did you hear what he said?" the first spy asked. Their bodies were covered in darkness, and it was almost impossible to see or locate them.
"No," the other answered.

This duo of spies was the best among all the others and most trusted by the king. Just from the fact that Henry sent them here, it was obvious how important this matter was to him. So the two became extremely careful, not to miss even a tiny detail, even if it seemed useless.
Whatever they were seeing was also being recorded by a glyph.

A few minutes passed, but there were absolutely no changes. Vritra was still resting, and the three women were chatting about random things. But this didn’t bore the two spies—they could continue to keep watch like this for days. They had even completed assassination missions for the king before.
"Forbid: Sound!!"
[Forbidden Activated!!]
The two spies felt air rustling against their bodies, and they paid it no mind. But in the next moment, two hands appeared out of nowhere and wrapped around the head of the first spy.
The first spy tried to scream and inform the other, but no voice came out of his mouth. He was so baffled by the sudden change that he couldn’t react in time.
WHOOSH
With another faint sound of air, the first spy disappeared.

A couple of seconds passed, and the second spy felt that something was amiss. He glanced to the side but only saw two palms before they wrapped around his head and twisted it backward with a crackling sound.
The second assassin didn’t die just from the breaking of his neck. He was still in perfect control of his body—but then his body was dragged through the air, away from the city at an extreme speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 191: So many!!
paragraphs: Diana, Fiona, and Vanessa talked casually. They glanced briefly at Vritra and knew that it was nothing more than a clone.
In his hands rested the cube given to him by the king. Only Vanessa had some idea about the current situation; she had sensed Henry’s intention earlier.
No one noticed as the two spies were dragged out of the city at a blinding speed. Vritra didn’t care even if others might have sensed him at that moment—he needed to do this.
Holding the two spies by the back of their necks, his fingers piercing into their bodies, he soon arrived outside the city and into the forest, at the place he had made out with Diana.
After making sure no one was around, Yasmine created a barrier around the three of them as Vritra threw the two onto the ground before slowly landing in front of them.
"Y- You? Who are you?" the first spy asked, his neck twisted back, eyes full of fear as he fixed his gaze on Vritra.
{Sin Point Gained: Paralyzed +2}NovelBin.
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +2}
"D- Demon?" the second spy also twisted his neck forward and was shocked to see two horns above Vritra’s head and that bluish energy rushing out of his body.
Switch had been activated, but at only 0.5%, which Vritra could handle without much problem. But even with just that much, his strength had grown significantly.
He could kill the two spies in a moment.
"Yes, a demon." Vritra nodded. For a moment, he disappeared from his position and then reappeared, blood dripping from the tips of his fingers.

"..." Both the spies didn’t even notice anything for a few moments until pain coursed through their bodies. All four of their limbs had been torn apart, and in that instant, Vritra had left their bodies severely injured, such that they couldn’t even exert a little strength.
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +2}
"Ughhhh COUGH S- Spare us... ughhhh please..." the first spy begged, looking utterly miserable, while the other wasn’t even able to speak since his throat had been ripped away from his body.
"I guess I will give you a faster death since you were just following your orders. It’s not your fault—but you just served the wrong person." Vritra said.
He extended his hands toward the two as demonic energy rushed forward and consumed them, killing them within moments.
The strength of these two assassins was higher than Bobby, yet Vritra was able to kill them with such ease. It finally seemed he had gotten a bit stronger—but this was nowhere near enough.
[Activated Suck! Suck! Suck!]
"Extract!!"

Vritra pointed at the first spy’s corpse as invisible flames burst out of his body and consumed the pieces of it. A large amount of mana was consumed by the Nihil-Anima as the transformation to becoming a soul wraith started.
But just this level of energy consumption was nothing for Vritra anymore—especially with that great skill of his that sounded quite strange.

It wasn’t long before another Legion ranked soul wraith stood in front of Vritra. After taking a breath, Vritra did the same with the other corpse and soon both the spies had become Vritra’s soldiers.
Though he wasn’t planning to keep them for long. Once his strength increased, they would be useless. Instead, he would let Bob and Bobby consume them later after they had fulfilled their task.

"Dark Knight and the others are already quite close to reaching that level too. But now that my opponents are too strong, that won’t be enough." Vritra mumbled. He wondered if there was a way to let those soul wraiths grow even faster but decided to ask Yasmine about it later.
"Go and try to assassinate the king. Do your best." Vritra commanded as the two soul wraiths bowed before disappearing from his sight.

Of course, there was no way they would be able to finish this task. After all, the king himself was at the peak of the 1st Legion rank. But it was just to give a little scare to Henry and keep him busy for a little while.
And once his strength increased, Henry wouldn’t be able to do anything anyway.
"Now that it is done, let’s see the rewards of my hard work."
Vritra first glanced at his sin points. He had several ideas on how to use them.
{Sin Points: 23,748,502}
"Nice!!" Vritra exclaimed in excitement. His days of hard work weren’t for nothing after all. Acting as Jin Woo was harder than Daddy V, but it was so worth it.
With so many points, he could do several things: buying stat points, luck points, drawing out new skills, upgrading the existing skills, and more.
His stats were already quite high for his level, and right now, just increasing them won’t make too big of a difference unless he reaches the Legion rank.
Buying luck points is a great option, but if he invests in that right now, there probably won’t be many points left to rotate the wheel.

In the end, Vritra came to the conclusion that upgrading one of his skills was the best option. All the skills obtained from the Divine Sin Wheel were already so great—upgrading them by one level would certainly make them a whole lot more deadly.
But which skill should I upgrade?
He needed to make the right decision in that aspect. Of course, he planned to upgrade them all sooner or later, but he would first upgrade the ones that would instantly make his strength grow.

"I will have to think a bit more about that, but Shift is the top contender for these points—and Forbidden too and... sigh, all skills are too good." Vritra sighed and decided to check out the other rewards.
He took out the black cube given to him by that ninja like man. It was just the same size as all the others. Vritra had noticed after looking at it for a few seconds and asked:
"Wifey, so how do I use this item?"

"It is a high level storage glyph. You just need to inject a bit of your mana and it will be bonded to you. And you don’t have to worry about them playing any tricks on the cube like the king." Yasmine replied, but then she added:

"Yeah, but there is indeed a tracking device in that emblem they provided. Though it seems they don’t plan to keep an eye on you all the time—it will most probably be used to find you when that marriage trial starts."
"..." Vritra injected his mana into the cube and could instantly sense the space within the storage glyph and the things resting inside. He took them all out at once.
There was a beautiful golden sword, a piece of cloth that seemed nothing more than a handkerchief, a diamond like empty stone, and an emblem that had a claw mark on it.

"Should I just throw this emblem? It’s not like I have any interest in marrying some random girl or anything." Vritra mumbled as he held the token in his hand. Letting someone track you could be really dangerous after all.
"Hmm, do as you wish—but it has the Emperor’s stamp over it and it could be really useful in the future." Yasmine replied.

paragraphs: "As for that tracking thing, although it can’t be blocked, it might not be a bad thing unless your identity is revealed," Yasmine replied.
After thinking for a few seconds, Vritra threw the emblem away with all his might deep into the forest; after all, obtaining it was never his goal.

"Haa, now I feel much better. It is impossible to hide my identity for too long, and later this thing just might become the cause of my death," Vritra mumbled. Finally, he looked at the remaining items.

Then he picked up the sword that looked beautiful and very expensive. After observing the sword, which was at the peak of 1st legion rank, for a few seconds, he knew instantly what he needed to do.
NovelBin
Taking out his Axes of Chaos, he put them down on the ground with their handles pointing upwards while holding the golden sword in his hand.
After thinking of the kind of changes he wanted, he began...
[Weapon Fusion Activated.]
The expensive sword and the axes glowed with a bright, blinding light, and then the sword disappeared from Vritra’s hand. The axes seemed to be going through a major change unlike any fusion before.
The pressure around them increased, the patterns and structure of the weapons changed, and they started releasing a sharp aura.

After a few minutes, the fusion had finally finished, and in front of Vritra lay the two brand-new axes, looking more majestic than ever. They seemed as if anything could be torn apart by those blades or crushed into minced meat by those heavy hammers.
Weapon: Axes of Chaos
Grade: Early 2nd legion rank
Vritra picked up the axes and waved them around. He could sense the destructive power of his weapons—they had grown to such a high level.

"Now this is great. These weapons were lagging behind because of my fast growth, but this level will be fine for some time, and then I could upgrade them again." Vritra slashed lightly, and a long crack appeared in the ground, coursing over tens of meters.

After getting used to the feel of them, he placed them back in his inventory. He was completely satisfied with the first gift. Now, looking at the piece of cloth, which was the peak of 1st legion rank as well, Vritra pondered and decided to give it to Fiona.
Soon, people of that level won’t be able to hurt him anyway, so it was pretty much useless for him. He placed the strange armor away as well—now only the empty stone remained.

"Wifey, how big will the commotion be if I use the stone right here to level up?" Vritra asked while holding the empty stone. Just by touching it, he could feel as if some sort of bottleneck was about to be removed.

"Normally it should be fine, others won’t notice at such a distance. But you aren’t normal. Just based on your physiques and stat points, the commotion shouldn’t be small, so if you do it right here, then there is a high chance that many will notice," Yasmine replied.
"..." Vritra fell silent. It could’ve been fine if others knew he had reached the legion rank, but by leveling up here, there was a chance that it could be revealed that he is a demon.
"Hmm, I guess I need to travel a bit further away then," Vritra mumbled. He couldn’t level up while being in the fourth dimension since he needed mana from the air.
In the end, he decided to first return to the city and move the three women to a different location. Finally, after they had settled in a bit more secure place, he could return back here to level up.
Vritra didn’t want to waste any time. After clearing all the traces from the surroundings, he disappeared.
Near the three women, Vritra finally opened his eyes and stood straight. Then he spoke in a low voice:
"I have taken care of the two spies sent by the king. I was right—he might have noticed that you are a succubus, so he might do more. But for now, he will be busy with other things."

All three of them listened carefully and sighed. Somehow they were already in a very bad relationship with the king, and as it seemed, Vritra might be planning to put a new king on the throne for the Blue Kingdom.
"What do you plan to do next?" Diana asked with a serious expression.

"For now, we will be moving out of that hotel and staying at another place—somewhere more secure so the king can’t find you too soon. As for the king, I will take care of him, though I don’t plan to make a move directly unless he tries something," Vritra said.
After talking for a bit longer, they left the hotel. Yasmine and Vritra made sure that no one was following them as they searched for a better hotel—somewhere with high privacy and better rooms.
And it wasn’t difficult to find one. They moved far enough from the competition venue and stayed away from the temple. It was better to not be close to the Grieves as well, after all.

Vritra booked a suite of sorts, which had several rooms. Diana had stolen quite a lot of money from the Dunshire Kingdom, so they weren’t short of money. After booking the best room in one of the best hotels,

Vritra helped set up the place and made sure there was no problem around it. He needed to be away for a short time anyway, so he wasn’t too worried. He left Bob and Bobby there, and it wasn’t long before the two spies had returned when their mission of killing the king had failed.
So Vritra left behind a total of four protectors. He brought Fiona to her room and sat beside her on the bed.
"Take this armor. It should help you greatly until your strength has improved," he said.
"No, you should use it. I can just hide in your arms, hehe," Fiona said as she snuggled into his arms and rubbed her cheek against his chest, inhaling his scent.

"It won’t be of much help to me anyway, so use it. Just insert some of your mana in it and it will start working instantly—oh right, you don’t have any inventory, right?" Vritra took out the black glyph and handed it to Fiona. It was empty, and he didn’t really need it.
"Whoa, what is this thing?" she asked, her eyes shining in curiosity.
After explaining about the glyph to her, the two of them walked out of the room. Diana and Vanessa were sitting on the sofa there. Vritra informed them about his short trip and spoke:
"I will be back quickly, and when I return, my strength will be much higher."
Though only one of the things he said was going to come true.
After giving hugs to the three women, he walked out of the hotel and began walking in the market street while pondering several things.
GRRRRRRRRRR...
CRACK
Just then, a loud sound thundered like lightning striking the earth, and then the sound of something breaking rang out. Vritra was startled as he looked around hastily.

chapters.title: Chapter 193: Frozen
paragraphs: Since it was still bright outside, the street was bustling with a large crowd. All the people were still excited about the recent competition.
Vritra walked calmly in the crowd; there really were no spies around.

’I need someone for my plan of killing the king, hmm who could I use?’ he pondered. Vritra was also quite excited by the prospect of leveling up and upgrading his skills, and even getting new soul wraiths.
He decided to go to the corner of the city with a carriage since it was better to avoid attention for now as much as possible. Who knows what kind of monstrous people are hiding in the kingdom.
Just as he located a carriage, a strange phenomenon occurred.
GRRRRRRRRR...
CRAACCCKKKKK
Hearing those strange and ear-piercing noises, everyone present there was startled. It was almost as if several buildings had collided at once, or a large bomb had detonated.
{Sin Point Gained: Got startled +1}

Vritra looked around and saw no collapsed building or any sign of destruction, but suddenly everything seemed to have turned dark. Everyone looked at the sky and was shocked to see the sky crack like a glass mirror.

A big rift had appeared there and cracks spread across it. Panic spread through the public as almost all the people shivered in fear. The guards patrolling across the streets rushed forward but were just as confused.

After a few seconds, a human silhouette became visible from the rift, though it was too bright to see clearly. But after a few moments, a strong aura spread across the entire city, freezing every single person present there — the king, guards, all people in their houses, the people on the street...
Even Vritra, who was about to activate the fourth dimension, had frozen.
Then she became visible... in a red dress and a heavy presence. The gorgeous woman wearing a veil — just at the first sight, everyone recognized her as the empress they had seen not too long ago.

Although her face was still not visible, just from her eyes everyone could tell that she was really mad, not to mention the heavy pressure that had frozen almost all the people in the kingdom except the strong fighters sent by the emperor.

’So like the Grieves were mentioning, did she really fail to obtain the inheritance? Don’t tell me she plans to kill everyone here just to vent her anger,’ Vritra thought, trying to move his body, but he wasn’t able to. The difference in their strength was just too much.
She could destroy the entire kingdom if she just wished so.

Vritra was ready to use the Switch ability and let the energy of the demon lord rush out of his body. That would certainly allow him to move, but that was the last option, since it would reveal his identity.
And he can’t fight — heck, he can’t even escape from the empress if she decided to kill him, so he just waited like all the others.

"I don’t think she is the type of person who would commit a slaughter just because she failed once. Although she wouldn’t hesitate to do so to achieve her goal, she is a very cold and heartless woman.

If she really attacks, I will teleport you close to mother-in-law and the others, and we will try to escape then," Yasmine said in a solemn tone. Even she couldn’t predict what that empress was thinking right now.
’By the way, what is her name?’ Vritra asked, since right now he could do nothing but just stand frozen.
"She is Yennefer Aven, the greatest prodigy from the Aven family that is only second to the emperor’s family. The emperor had been chasing her for many years.

Even though they got engaged because of some hidden deal, she didn’t want to marry him or anyone. And seeing how she looks so angry upon failing to obtain the inheritance, then it must be extremely important to her," Yasmine answered.
’Yennefer Aven...’ Vritra repeated her name. While looking at that crazy woman, he wondered why the emperor was so mad about her; just because of her looks?
One needs to look at the personality of their partner too. This woman certainly looks crazy enough to kill her sleeping husband over even a little argument.
While everyone in the kingdom was staring at the sky in terror, Yennefer’s rage-filled blue pupils scanned the entire crowd. She looked over the area of several kilometres.
Her gaze momentarily paused over several people before moving on. After a few seconds...
{Sin Point Gained: Locked on +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Got startled +1}
Vritra was once again startled as the empress’s gaze suddenly landed on him. He waited for her gaze to continue moving like she was doing but...
One second...
Two seconds...
Three seconds...

The empress’s gaze remained fixed on him for a few seconds. Her piercing eyes seemed to pass through all the layers as if she could see all his secrets. Vritra could do nothing but stand there, letting her inspect him.
"Be ready to react the moment she does anything..." Yasmine said, as she got ready to activate the teleportation.

More than ten seconds passed, yet the empress continued to stare at him, looking like a beautiful statue in the sky. Then her gaze moved away as she scanned the entire place once again. This time she didn’t pause like before, as if she was just making sure of something the last time.
WHOOSH

With a light breeze, the intense pressure disappeared. Everyone was finally able to move, but they all stood rooted to their positions. After all, no one could be faster than her if she really decided to attack.
The king’s protector that Vritra had met before appeared beside Yennefer and, while bowing, he spoke respectfully.
"Empress, please don’t take your anger out on these people. Did you encounter some problem in there?" Han Gratt spoke — the childhood friend and protector of the emperor.

He kept his gaze low, but Vritra could sense something — an unrequited love interest. So it seemed this protector was in love with the empress as well, but he couldn’t act on his feelings because of his relation with the emperor.
’Sigh, what has happened to men’s taste nowadays? How could they like someone so violent?’ Vritra thought.
"By the way, I am not that violent at all," Yasmine added, just to be clear.
"..." Yennefer paid Han no attention as she continued to gaze at all the people for a few more seconds. Finally, her gaze returned to Vritra as if she had already made up her mind.
"Please tell me, Empress, is there anything I can do to—" Han Gratt began to speak, but Yennefer just disappeared all of a sudden from his sight.

He sighed at the stubborn empress, but he loved that side of her as well. Han looked around to look for her. His strength was comparable with the empress; there was only a little difference, with him being a bit weaker.
’Huh? Wait, why does it look like the empress is getting bigger?’ Vritra stared into the distance with narrowed eyes, then felt the empress rushing in his direction.
His first instinct was to turn around and run. It was too sudden, and Vritra had taken just one step away — but in the next moment, he found himself floating in the air.

But after a few moments, a strong aura spread across the entire city, freezing every single person present there — the king, guards, all people in their houses, the people on the street...
Even Vritra, who was about to activate the fourth dimension, had frozen.
Then she became visible... in a red dress and a heavy presence.
The gorgeous woman wearing a veil — just at the first sight, everyone recognized her as the empress they had seen not too long ago.

Although her face was still not visible, just from her eyes everyone could tell that she was really mad, not to mention the heavy pressure that had frozen almost all the people in the kingdom except the strong fighters sent by the emperor.
’So like the Grieves were mentioning, did she really fail to obtain the inheritance?
Don’t tell me she plans to kill everyone here just to vent her anger,’ Vritra thought, trying to move his body, but he wasn’t able to.
The difference in their strength was just too much.
She could destroy the entire kingdom if she just wished so.
Vritra was ready to use the Switch ability and let the energy of the demon lord rush out of his body.
That would certainly allow him to move, but that was the last option, since it would reveal his identity.
And he can’t fight — heck, he can’t even escape from the empress if she decided to kill him, so he just waited like all the others.
"I don’t think she is the type of person who would commit a slaughter just because she failed once.
Although she wouldn’t hesitate to do so to achieve her goal, she is a very cold and heartless woman.
If she really attacks, I will teleport you close to mother-in-law and the others, and we will try to escape then," Yasmine said in a solemn tone.
Even she couldn’t predict what that empress was thinking right now.
’By the way, what is her name?’ Vritra asked, since right now he could do nothing but just stand frozen.
"She is Yennefer Aven, the greatest prodigy from the Aven family that is only second to the emperor’s family.
The emperor had been chasing her for many years.
Even though they got engaged because of some hidden deal, she didn’t want to marry him or anyone.
And seeing how she looks so angry upon failing to obtain the inheritance, then it must be extremely important to her," Yasmine answered.
’Yennefer Aven...’ Vritra repeated her name.
While looking at that crazy woman, he wondered why the emperor was so mad about her; just because of her looks?
One needs to look at the personality of their partner too.
This woman certainly looks crazy enough to kill her sleeping husband over even a little argument.
While everyone in the kingdom was staring at the sky in terror, Yennefer’s rage-filled blue pupils scanned the entire crowd.
She looked over the area of several kilometres.
Her gaze momentarily paused over several people before moving on.
After a few seconds...
{Sin Point Gained: Locked on +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Got startled +1}
Vritra was once again startled as the empress’s gaze suddenly landed on him.
He waited for her gaze to continue moving like she was doing but...
One second...
Two seconds...
Three seconds...
The empress’s gaze remained fixed on him for a few seconds.
Her piercing eyes seemed to pass through all the layers as if she could see all his secrets.
Vritra could do nothing but stand there, letting her inspect him.
"Be ready to react the moment she does anything..." Yasmine said, as she got ready to activate the teleportation.
More than ten seconds passed, yet the empress continued to stare at him, looking like a beautiful statue in the sky.
Then her gaze moved away as she scanned the entire place once again.
This time she didn’t pause like before, as if she was just making sure of something the last time.
WHOOSH
With a light breeze, the intense pressure disappeared.
Everyone was finally able to move, but they all stood rooted to their positions.
After all, no one could be faster than her if she really decided to attack.
The king’s protector that Vritra had met before appeared beside Yennefer and, while bowing, he spoke respectfully.
"Empress, please don’t take your anger out on these people.
Did you encounter some problem in there?" Han Gratt spoke — the childhood friend and protector of the emperor.
He kept his gaze low, but Vritra could sense something — an unrequited love interest.
So it seemed this protector was in love with the empress as well, but he couldn’t act on his feelings because of his relation with the emperor.
’Sigh, what has happened to men’s taste nowadays?
How could they like someone so violent?’ Vritra thought.
"By the way, I am not that violent at all," Yasmine added, just to be clear.
"..." Yennefer paid Han no attention as she continued to gaze at all the people for a few more seconds.
Finally, her gaze returned to Vritra as if she had already made up her mind.
"Please tell me, Empress, is there anything I can do to—" Han Gratt began to speak, but Yennefer just disappeared all of a sudden from his sight.
He sighed at the stubborn empress, but he loved that side of her as well.
Han looked around to look for her.
His strength was comparable with the empress; there was only a little difference, with him being a bit weaker.
’Huh?
Wait, why does it look like the empress is getting bigger?’ Vritra stared into the distance with narrowed eyes, then felt the empress rushing in his direction.
His first instinct was to turn around and run.
It was too sudden, and Vritra had taken just one step away — but in the next moment, he found himself floating in the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 194: Abduction
paragraphs: Vritra suddenly felt light and couldn’t move his body. He wanted to run, but even his mind seemed to have slowed down while the space around him was completely sealed. Even Yasmine couldn’t teleport him away.
In the next moment, a fragrant scent like fresh flowers hit Vritra as the empress appeared right beside him. After staring at him closely for a few seconds, she grabbed his arm and began to fly away.
’W- What the hell is happening? Am I being abducted? Am I going to get killed?’ Vritra frowned. Being so close to this woman, there was little chance of his survival even with all his skills.
"D- Don’t worry, I don’t think she knows you are a demon yet." Yasmine tried to calm Vritra, even though she was panicking a bit herself.
’Oh, and how do you know that?’ Vritra asked while he was being dragged back towards the rift that had opened in the sky.
"Because you are still alive. No way she would allow any demon to breathe in such close proximity to herself.
She hates them with all her might. So whatever happens, you can’t reveal any of that—just make her believe you only possess the dragon’s physique and bloodline." Yasmine warned.
Even if she tried to sacrifice him now, it would result in nothing; Yennefer Aven is just too strong.

’I- I will do my best. But still, why would she target me out of all these people? Don’t tell me she fell for me at first sight or something—though the faint killing intent I sense says otherwise.’ Vritra could only wait for now.

"Empress, what are you doing? Do you plan to kill him?" Han asked as he gazed at Vritra and felt he seemed a bit familiar. At such high levels, even their memories had improved a lot, so after a few seconds, he recognized Vritra.

"Oh, isn’t that Jin Woo? Empress, he is the winner of the competition today, so I don’t think it is a good idea to kill him. Why don’t you just kill a few others to appease your anger?" Han said, and Vritra looked at the empress’s back in hope, but she didn’t even pay any attention to the protector’s words.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +82,593}
{Sin Point Gained: Pitied +82,992}
{Sin Point Gained: Envied +1,356}

"Sigh, do as you wish. If killing him can make you happier, then so be it." Han Gratt straightened and shrugged his shoulders. He just watched as the empress dragged the helpless Vritra into the space rift.
Soon, the space rift disappeared and everything returned to normal. The protector stared at the empty space for a few seconds before shaking his head and disappearing.
Vritra might be one of the contenders for that marriage trial, but what can be done when the empress wishes to kill him?
All the people who had just seen the abduction sighed in pity. They had heard of the high temper of the empress and how she would just kill whenever she wanted.
They all knew that Jin Woo had won the competition not long ago and they were sure he was going to be someone big in the future—but now there won’t be a future for him.

After passing through the rift, Vritra found himself in a large room-shaped space. Though it was completely empty, as if everything that had once existed there had disappeared, the walls were painted in different colours.
The windows and doors were shut tight. Aside from that, there was absolutely nothing in the room.
Yennefer let go of his arm as Vritra landed on his feet. After observing his surroundings and trying to find any way of escape, he fixed his eyes on the empress.
"A- Are you going to k- kill me?" Vritra asked, appearing really afraid, even as he thought of all kinds of possibilities—any chance of escaping her.
But Vritra was indeed going to fight a deadly battle with the empress earlier than he could have expected. One single attack from her would lead to his death—she really had plans to kill him.
"Show me your real face." Yennefer turned and stood in front of Vritra, staring directly into his eyes.
"T- True face? W- What do you mean?" he asked, continuing with his fearful act. Though he had a feeling anything in front of this woman would be useless.
Her face remained absolutely emotionless as she continued: "If you speak gibberish one more time, then I will kill you right here and bring someone else for my task."
’So she really needs me for something. Sigh, thankfully she didn’t bring me here just to kill me. But I have a feeling she will kill me very soon.’ Vritra gulped in nervousness as he nodded.

"Just follow her instructions for now. We are inside the Scarlet Inheritance. I will look through the map and find some way to escape." Yasmine suggested as she began to study the map he had obtained.
’My life is in your hands now, wifey...’ Vritra said.
[Intra Shuffle activated.]
His face twisted and soon another face appeared—though that wasn’t his real face either.
"..." Yennefer frowned as she raised her right hand. A dangerous energy began to gather in her palm.
"Wait, wait, I am sorry. I will do it." Vritra sighed in self-pity as his face twisted once again, and finally, his real face—much more handsome than the fake one—appeared.
It seemed although Yennefer couldn’t see his real face, she somehow knew which ones weren’t.
The empress stared at his face and then nodded. She looked at the wall and then began to speak in her cold, emotionless tone:
"This is the Scarlet Couple Inheritance, and it is really very important to me. No matter what, I can’t afford to not obtain the inheritance. I have to get it at any cost."

"I- Is that so? Well, did you bring me here to ask for my permission or something? I h- have no problem with it, so please go ahead. Now I will excuse myself." After saying that, he turned—but couldn’t see any exit.
Right now, only one of his hearts was beating while the other remained hidden. Not even dragons possess two hearts. If she heard two heartbeats from his chest, then she would surely kill him.
"Are you a dragon?" Yennefer wasted no time as she asked, ignoring his acting and jokes.
"Uh... yes." Vritra nodded, as scales appeared over his cheek and arms.
The empress stared at them carefully, as if she was confirming her doubts. She really was suspecting Vritra of being a demon, but seeing those scales, she seemed convinced as she gave another nod.
"So, why did you bring me here, e- Empress?" Vritra asked respectfully. He really couldn’t think why—aside from the reason that she wanted to kill him.
"What is your name? You are from the Blue Kingdom? What about your family?" she asked, ignoring his question.
"I am J- Jin Woo. Yes, I am. I have no other family members, I live alone." He answered carefully, honesty dripping from his face.
She stepped forward and grabbed his wrist, and began to sense something. A few seconds passed in silence, then she stepped back.
Yennefer spoke in the same emotionless tone: "So Jin Woo, I need to borrow your penis for a moment."
"Um... Sorry, what?"
